Dabei denkst du nicht nur in einzelnen Features, sondern betrachtest die gesamte Customer Journey und trägst dazu bei, das digitale Kundenerlebnis kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Was ist der Inhalt der Rolle?

• Du arbeitest eng mit dem Product Owner zusammen, analysierst fachliche Anforderungen und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit den Stakeholdern nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für unsere E-Banking-Plattform – von der Priorisierung bis zur Konkretisierung einzelner Initiativen.

• Du erstellst Business Requirements, User Stories, Fachkonzepte und Prozessbeschreibungen und begleitest diese über den gesamten Entwicklungszyklus hinweg.

• Du begleitest neue Funktionen von der Idee über Spezifikation und Implementierung bis zu Test, Einführung und Betrieb und stellst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungs- und UX-Teams sicher, dass Anforderungen verständlich, vollständig und effizient umgesetzt werden.

• Du führst fachliche Abnahmen und User Acceptance Tests durch und stellst die Qualität neuer Funktionen sicher.

• Du analysierst Produktionsprobleme, koordinierst die Ursachenanalyse und leitest gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams nachhaltige Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

• Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in bestehenden Prozessen und treibst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Kanäle voran.

Was sind die Anforderungen?
Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Anforderungen eines modernen E-Bankings und begeisterst dich dafür, komplexe Herausforderungen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Technologie zu lösen.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Business Analyst, Business Engineer oder Requirements Engineer im Banken- oder Finanzumfeld.

• Erfahrung in der Analyse, Konzeption und Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen, vorzugsweise im Bereich E-Banking oder Digital Banking.

• Ein gutes Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprozessen, digitalen Kundenerlebnissen und modernen UX-Prinzipien.

• Freude daran, komplexe Sachverhalte zu strukturieren und verständlich zu dokumentieren.

• Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie eine selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

• Technisches Grundverständnis, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen in SQL, APIs oder Avaloq.

• Erfahrung im Testing und in der fachlichen Qualitätssicherung von Applikationen.

• Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.

• Deutsch und Englisch beherrschst du fliessend in Wort und Schrift.

• Affinität für Artificial Intelligence (AI) und Bereitschaft, mit AI Tools zu arbeiten.

Was bieten wir?

• Ein hochinteressantes Arbeitsumfeld mit komplexen Fragestellungen, moderner Technologie und einem starken Innovationsfokus.

• Ein dynamisches und internationales Umfeld mit vielen Ideen, das Flexibilität und die kontinuierliche Kalibrierung der Prioritäten erfordert, ohne das langfristige Ziel aus den Augen zu verlieren.

• Die Möglichkeit, Ende-zu-Ende-Perspektiven auf das Client Management zu gewinnen und Prozesse über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg zu gestalten.

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und zahlreiche Chancen, Neues zu lernen und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Wir suchen nach talentierten Menschen und nicht nur nach einem Lebenslauf, der alle Kriterien erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht alles mitbringst, was wir von dir verlangen, solltest du dich bewerben.

Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel gestalten Sie eine bessere Zukunft – für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und ihre eigene. Als familiengeführtes, börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Mitarbeitenden an 28 Standorten weltweit und Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit.
Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt unterschiedliche Perspektiven, und wir suchen Menschen, die in einer dynamischen und sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung, wenn Sie sich für die Stelle begeistern.
Möchten Sie Vontobel werden?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description

En tant que Business Analyst au sein de l’équipe E-Banking, vous contribuez activement à façonner l’avenir numérique de notre plateforme Private Clients. Vous faites le lien entre le métier et l’IT et veillez à ce que les besoins des clients, les exigences réglementaires et les possibilités techniques soient traduits en solutions innovantes et conviviales.

En étroite collaboration avec les départements spécialisés, les développeurs, les experts UX et les partenaires externes, vous analysez les exigences, élaborez des concepts et accompagnez leur mise en œuvre jusqu’à leur mise en production réussie. Ce faisant, vous ne vous limitez pas à des fonctionnalités individuelles, mais considérez l’ensemble du parcours client et contribuez à améliorer en continu l’expérience client numérique.

En quoi consiste le poste ?

- Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Product Owner, analysez les exigences métier et élaborez avec les parties prenantes des solutions durables et innovantes pour notre plateforme E-Banking – de la priorisation à la concrétisation d’initiatives individuelles.
- Vous rédigez les exigences métier, les User Stories, les concepts fonctionnels et les descriptions de processus, et en assurez le suivi tout au long du cycle de développement.
- Vous accompagnez les nouvelles fonctionnalités de l’idée à l’exploitation, en passant par la spécification, l’implémentation, les tests et le déploiement, et veillez, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement et UX, à ce que les exigences soient claires, complètes et mises en œuvre efficacement.
- Vous effectuez les recettes fonctionnelles et les tests d’acceptation utilisateur, et garantissez la qualité des nouvelles fonctionnalités.
- Vous analysez les problèmes en production, coordonnez l’analyse des causes et définissez, avec les équipes concernées, des mesures d’amélioration durables.
- Vous identifiez les potentiels d’optimisation des processus existants et faites avancer le développement continu de nos canaux numériques.

Quelles sont les exigences ?

Vous disposez d’une compréhension approfondie des exigences d’un E-Banking moderne et êtes enthousiaste à l’idée de relever des défis complexes à l’interface entre le métier et la technologie.

- Plusieurs années d’expérience en tant que Business Analyst, Business Engineer ou Requirements Engineer dans le secteur bancaire ou financier.
- Expérience dans l’analyse, la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions numériques, de préférence dans le domaine de l’e-banking ou du digital banking.
- Une bonne compréhension des processus de développement logiciel, des expériences clients numériques et des principes UX modernes.
- Vous aimez structurer des sujets complexes et les documenter de manière compréhensible.
- Esprit d’analyse ainsi qu’une manière de travailler autonome et orientée vers les solutions.
- Compréhension technique de base, idéalement avec des connaissances en SQL, en APIs ou dans Avaloq.
- Expérience dans les tests et l’assurance qualité fonctionnelle des applications.
- Excellentes compétences en communication et plaisir à collaborer avec différentes parties prenantes.
- Vous maîtrisez couramment l’allemand et l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
- Affinité pour l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et volonté de travailler avec des outils d’IA.

Que proposons-nous ?

- Un environnement de travail très intéressant, avec des problématiques complexes, des technologies modernes et un fort accent sur l’innovation.
- Un environnement dynamique et international, riche en idées, qui exige de la flexibilité et un ajustement continu des priorités, sans perdre de vue l’objectif à long terme.
- La possibilité d’acquérir une vision de bout en bout de la gestion des clients et de concevoir des processus au-delà des frontières entre départements.
- Une grande autonomie et de nombreuses occasions d’apprendre de nouvelles choses et de continuer à vous développer.

Nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses, et pas seulement un CV qui répond à tous les critères. Même si vous ne possédez pas tout ce que nous vous demandons, vous devriez postuler.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?

Chez Vontobel, vous contribuez à façonner un avenir meilleur – pour nos clients, la société et le vôtre. En tant qu’entreprise familiale cotée en bourse, comptant plus de 2.000 collaborateurs répartis sur 28 sites dans le monde et dont le siège est à Zurich, nous misons sur une vision à long terme et la durabilité.

Notre équipe diverse apprécie la pluralité des points de vue et nous recherchons des personnes qui souhaitent faire bouger les choses dans un monde dynamique et en pleine évolution. Même si vous ne remplissez pas tous les critères, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature si le poste vous enthousiasme.

Souhaitez-vous rejoindre Vontobel ?

Candidature

Merci d’avoir postulé chez Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre candidature et vous répondrons dans les meilleurs délais.

Chez Vontobel, nous sommes un employeur qui garantit l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à offrir des opportunités d’emploi égales, indépendamment de la race, de la couleur de peau, de l’ascendance, de la religion, du sexe, de l’origine nationale, de l’orientation sexuelle, de l’âge, de la citoyenneté, de l’état matrimonial, du handicap ou de l’identité de genre.

Nous valorisons les nombreuses voix au sein de nos équipes et nous engageons à créer un environnement où toute personne souhaitant faire partie de notre culture de la performance peut rester elle-même. Celle-ci repose sur le respect mutuel et une tolérance zéro à l’égard de toute forme de discrimination.

Contact

Si vous avez des questions, vous pouvez nous contacter via notre formulaire de contact .

jobs.description:
Are you a digitally savvy marketing professional who combines strategic thinking, strong analytical capabilities, and execution excellence? Are you passionate about creating seamless digital client journeys, optimizing user experiences, leveraging data and AI, and driving measurable commercial outcomes?

Vontobel Asset Management is seeking a highly motivated Digital Marketing Manager to join the Client Content Center and help shape the future of our digital marketing capabilities.

This role reports directly to the Head of Digital Marketing & Content. The successful candidate will play a critical role in enhancing digital client experiences, optimizing digital touchpoints, and delivering measurable business impact through data-driven marketing.

The role sits at the intersection of digital marketing, client experience, analytics, content generation, and business growth. A key focus will be connecting digital marketing activities to commercial objectives, fundraising priorities, client engagement, and business outcomes through robust performance measurement and continuous optimization.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a candidate who brings:

• Proven experience developing and optimizing digital client journeys across websites, campaigns, email, and other digital touchpoints.

• Strong expertise in digital marketing, UX optimization, website management, conversion optimization, and client engagement.

• Excellent data literacy and a deep understanding of digital marketing KPIs, analytics, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.

• Demonstrated ability to turn data and client insights into actionable recommendations that drive commercial impact.

• Experience establishing and managing dashboards that measure engagement, lead generation, conversion, client journeys, and business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of marketing technologies, CRM platforms, automation tools, and digital analytics solutions.

• Passion for Artificial Intelligence, automation, personalization, and emerging technologies.

• Experience leveraging AI to improve client engagement, digital experiences, scalability, operational efficiency, and marketing effectiveness.

• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across marketing, distribution, investments, product management, technology, and compliance.

• A growth mindset, strong curiosity, and a passion for continuous improvement and innovation.

Key responsibilities

Digital client journeys & client experience

• Design, manage, and continuously optimize digital client journeys across the full client lifecycle.

• Enhance client engagement, conversion, and retention through personalization and journey optimization.

• Ensure digital experiences support commercial priorities, fundraising objectives, and client needs.
User experience & digital platforms

• Drive continuous improvements of website usability, navigation, accessibility, and conversion performance.

• Conduct user research, behavioral analysis, and testing to identify optimization opportunities.

• Implement best practices in UX and digital experience management across client-facing platforms.
Digital analytics & KPI leadership

• Develop and maintain KPI frameworks, dashboards, and reporting that measure digital performance and business impact.

• Monitor and optimize key digital KPIs including engagement, leads, conversions, traffic quality, and client journey effectiveness.

• Generate insights and recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and contribute to commercial growth.
AI, automation & innovation

• Identify and implement AI-driven solutions that enhance digital marketing performance and client experiences.

• Drive the adoption of marketing automation, personalization, predictive analytics, and new digital capabilities.

• Promote innovation and continuous experimentation across the digital marketing ecosystem.
Digital campaign activation

• Support the execution and optimization of integrated digital campaigns across all relevant channels with relevant stakeholders

• Maximize performance across website, email, social media, paid media, and marketing automation platforms.

• Partner with marketing teams to increase effectiveness and reach.

Candidate Profile

• University degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, digital experience management, performance marketing, or related fields.

• Experience within asset management, financial services, banking, or another regulated industry preferred.

• Strong expertise in digital analytics platforms, web analytics, CRM systems, website management, and marketing automation technologies.

• Demonstrated success in developing KPI frameworks and using data to drive decision-making and optimization.

• Strong understanding of digital client journeys, UX principles, customer behavior, and conversion optimization.

• Experience leveraging AI-powered marketing tools and modern digital technologies.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams in an international environment.

Personal profile

• Highly client-centric and digitally minded.

• Strong analytical thinker with exceptional data literacy skills.

• Commercially focused with a clear understanding of growth drivers and business outcomes.

• Passionate about AI, technology, innovation, and digital transformation.

• Collaborative and influential with strong stakeholder management capabilities.

• Curious, proactive, and continuously seeking opportunities to improve performance.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Hands-on, results-oriented, and focused on measurable impact.

Location Requirement

This role is based in Zurich but will move to Baar in 2030, ensuring close alignment with key stakeholders in the business.

What do we offer?

• Experienced, diverse team in an international environment

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei un professionista di marketing digitalmente esperto che combina il pensiero strategico, le capacità analitiche forti e l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione? Sei appassionato di creare viaggi client digitali senza soluzione di continuità, ottimizzando le esperienze degli utenti, sfruttando i dati e l'IA, e guidando risultati commerciali misurabili?

Vontobel Asset Management sta cercando un Digital Marketing Manager altamente motivato per aderire al Customer Content Center e contribuire a plasmare il futuro delle nostre capacità di marketing digitale.

Questo ruolo si riferisce direttamente al responsabile del marketing digitale e dei contenuti. Il candidato di successo svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel migliorare le esperienze dei clienti digitali, ottimizzare i touchpoint digitali e fornire un impatto commerciale misurabile attraverso il marketing basato sui dati.

Il ruolo si trova all'incrocio tra marketing digitale, esperienza client, analisi, generazione di contenuti e crescita aziendale. Un focus chiave sarà la connessione di attività di marketing digitale a obiettivi commerciali, priorità di raccolta fondi, coinvolgimento dei clienti e risultati aziendali attraverso la misurazione robusta delle prestazioni e l'ottimizzazione continua.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

Stiamo cercando un candidato che porta:

• Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo e nell'ottimizzazione dei viaggi dei clienti digitali su siti web, campagne, email e altri touchpoint digitali.

• Forte competenza nel marketing digitale, ottimizzazione UX, gestione del sito web, ottimizzazione delle conversioni e coinvolgimento del cliente.

• Eccellente alfabetizzazione dei dati e una profonda comprensione dei KPI di marketing digitale, analisi, framework di reporting e misurazione delle prestazioni.

• Capacità dimostrata di trasformare i dati e le intuizioni dei clienti in raccomandazioni attuabili che spingono l'impatto commerciale.

• Prova a stabilire e gestire dashboard che misurano l'impegno, la generazione di piombo, la conversione, i viaggi dei clienti e i risultati aziendali.

• Forte comprensione delle tecnologie di marketing, piattaforme CRM, strumenti di automazione e soluzioni di analisi digitale.

• Passione per l'intelligenza artificiale, l'automazione, la personalizzazione e le tecnologie emergenti.

• Esperienza sfruttando AI per migliorare il coinvolgimento dei clienti, le esperienze digitali, la scalabilità, l'efficienza operativa e l'efficacia del marketing.

• Forte capacità di gestione e collaborazione degli stakeholder attraverso il marketing, la distribuzione, gli investimenti, la gestione dei prodotti, la tecnologia e la conformità.

• Una mentalità di crescita, una forte curiosità e una passione per il miglioramento continuo e l'innovazione.

Responsabilità chiave

Viaggi client digitali e esperienza cliente

• Progettare, gestire e ottimizzare continuamente i viaggi dei clienti digitali attraverso il ciclo di vita completo del cliente.

• Migliorare il coinvolgimento del cliente, la conversione e la ritenzione attraverso la personalizzazione e l'ottimizzazione del viaggio.

• Assicurarsi che le esperienze digitali supportino le priorità commerciali, gli obiettivi di raccolta fondi e le esigenze dei clienti.
Esperienza utente e piattaforme digitali

• Guidare miglioramenti continui di usabilità del sito web, navigazione, accessibilità e prestazioni di conversione.

• Condurre ricerca utente, analisi comportamentale e test per identificare opportunità di ottimizzazione.

• Implementare le migliori pratiche in UX e la gestione dell'esperienza digitale su piattaforme client-facing.
Analisi digitale e leadership KPI

• Sviluppare e mantenere framework KPI, dashboard e reporting che misurano le prestazioni digitali e l'impatto aziendale.

• Monitorare e ottimizzare i KPI digitali chiave tra cui impegno, lead, conversioni, qualità del traffico e l'efficacia del viaggio client.

• Generare intuizioni e raccomandazioni che migliorano l'efficacia del marketing e contribuiscono alla crescita commerciale.
AI, automazione e innovazione

• Identificare e implementare soluzioni AI-driven che migliorano le prestazioni di marketing digitale e le esperienze dei clienti.

• Guidare l'adozione di automazione di marketing, personalizzazione, analisi predittiva e nuove capacità digitali.

• Promuovere l'innovazione e la sperimentazione continua nell'ecosistema di marketing digitale.
Attivazione della campagna digitale

• Sostenere l'esecuzione e l'ottimizzazione di campagne digitali integrate in tutti i canali pertinenti con gli stakeholder rilevanti

• Ottimizzare le prestazioni attraverso le piattaforme di web, email, social media, pay media e marketing automation.

• Partner con team di marketing per aumentare l'efficacia e raggiungere.

Profilo del candidato

• Laurea in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Comunicazioni, Data Analytics, o una disciplina relativa.

• 5+ anni di esperienza nel marketing digitale, nella gestione delle esperienze digitali, nel marketing delle prestazioni o nei campi correlati.

• Esperienza all'interno di asset management, servizi finanziari, banche o un altro settore regolamentato preferito.

• Forte esperienza nelle piattaforme di analisi digitali, analisi web, sistemi CRM, gestione del sito web e tecnologie di automazione di marketing.

• Il successo dimostrato nello sviluppo dei framework KPI e nell'utilizzo dei dati per guidare il processo decisionale e l'ottimizzazione.

• Forte comprensione dei viaggi client digitali, principi UX, comportamento del cliente e ottimizzazione della conversione.

• Esperienza sfruttando strumenti di marketing basati su AI e moderne tecnologie digitali.

• Esperienza di lavoro con team interfunzionali in un ambiente internazionale.

Profilo personale

• Altamente client-centric e digitalmente pensato.

• Forte pensatore analitico con eccezionali capacità di alfabetizzazione dei dati.

• Commercialmente focalizzato con una chiara comprensione dei driver di crescita e dei risultati aziendali.

• Appassionato di AI, tecnologia, innovazione e trasformazione digitale.

• Collaborativo e influente con forti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder.

• Curioso, proattivo e continuamente alla ricerca di opportunità per migliorare le prestazioni.

• Funzionamento confortevole in un ambiente veloce ed in evoluzione.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione.

• Hands-on, orientata ai risultati e focalizzata sull'impatto misurabile.

Richiesta posizione

Questo ruolo ha sede a Zurigo, ma si trasferirà a Baar nel 2030, garantendo un allineamento ravvicinato con i principali stakeholder del business.

Cosa offriamo?

• Un team esperto e diversificato in un ambiente internazionale

• Ambiente aggressivo nel modo in cui pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli

• Spirito collaborativo con opportunità di imparare e prosperare

Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare.

A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Entro il 2030, vogliamo essere conosciuti come una delle principali e più affidabili aziende di investimento globali. Abbiamo 2.300+ professionisti impegnati, con sede in 27 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo.

Siamo entrambi di proprietà della famiglia di maggioranza e pubblicamente elencati. La nostra capacità di attenzione a lungo termine, su temi come la sostenibilità, è sostenuta dalla sicurezza dell’impegno della famiglia di 100 anni. Guidato da una mentalità di proprietà, è possibile sbloccare il vostro potenziale e tradurre intuizioni in opportunità. Assumiamo individui di talento che sono determinati a consegnare in un mondo in evoluzione e che provengono da una vasta gamma di sfondi. Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno delle nostre squadre e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

Vontobel Asset Management est à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de marketing numérique hautement motivé pour rejoindre le Centre de contenu client et aider à façonner l'avenir de nos capacités de marketing numérique.

Ce rôle relève directement du responsable du marketing numérique et du contenu. Ce rôle se situe à l'intersection du marketing numérique, de l'expérience client, de l'analyse, de la production de contenu et de la croissance des entreprises. L'un des principaux objectifs sera de relier les activités de marketing numérique aux objectifs commerciaux, aux priorités de financement, à l'engagement des clients et aux résultats opérationnels grâce à une mesure robuste du rendement et à une optimisation continue.

Que cherchons - nous?

Nous cherchons un candidat qui apporte :

• Expérience éprouvée de développement et d'optimisation des parcours de clients numériques à travers des sites Web, des campagnes, des courriels et d'autres points de contact numériques.

• Forte expertise en marketing numérique, optimisation UX, gestion de site Web, optimisation de la conversion et engagement client.

• Excellente connaissance des données et une compréhension approfondie des ICR du marketing numérique, des analyses, des cadres de rapport et de la mesure du rendement.

• Capacité démontrée de transformer les données et les connaissances des clients en recommandations réalisables qui ont un impact commercial.

• Passion pour l'intelligence artificielle, l'automatisation, la personnalisation et les technologies émergentes.

• Expérience en tirant parti de l'IA pour améliorer l'engagement des clients, les expériences numériques, l'évolutivité, l'efficience opérationnelle et l'efficacité du marketing.

• Fortes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en collaboration dans les domaines du marketing, de la distribution, des investissements, de la gestion des produits, de la technologie et de la conformité.

• Un état d'esprit en croissance, une forte curiosité et une passion pour l'amélioration continue et l'innovation.

Principales responsabilités

Voyages et expérience client numériques

• Concevoir, gérer et optimiser en permanence les voyages des clients numériques tout au long de leur cycle de vie.

• Améliorer l'engagement, la conversion et la rétention des clients grâce à la personnalisation et à l'optimisation du parcours.

• Veiller à ce que les expériences numériques appuient les priorités commerciales, les objectifs de collecte de fonds et les besoins des clients.
Expérience utilisateur et plateformes numériques

• Conduire des améliorations continues de l'utilisation du site Web, de la navigation, de l'accessibilité et des performances de conversion.

• Effectuer des recherches, des analyses comportementales et des tests pour identifier les possibilités d'optimisation.

• Mettre en oeuvre des pratiques exemplaires en matière de gestion des UX et de l'expérience numérique dans toutes les plateformes orientées vers les clients.
Analyse numérique et leadership KPI

• Élaborer et tenir à jour des cadres, des tableaux de bord et des rapports sur l'ICP qui mesurent la performance numérique et l'impact opérationnel.

• Surveiller et optimiser les KPI numériques clés, y compris l'engagement, les pistes, les conversions, la qualité du trafic et l'efficacité du parcours client.

• Générer des idées et des recommandations qui améliorent l'efficacité de la commercialisation et contribuent à la croissance commerciale.
AI, automatisation et innovation

• Identifier et mettre en œuvre des solutions axées sur l'IA qui améliorent la performance du marketing numérique et l'expérience client.

• Favoriser l'adoption de l'automatisation du marketing, de la personnalisation, de l'analyse prédictive et de nouvelles capacités numériques.

• Promouvoir l'innovation et l'expérimentation continue à travers l'écosystème du marketing numérique.
Activation numérique de la campagne

• Maximiser les performances sur les sites Web, les courriels, les médias sociaux, les médias payants et les plateformes d'automatisation du marketing.

• Expérience dans la gestion d'actifs, les services financiers, les banques ou une autre industrie réglementée préférée.

• Forte expertise dans les plateformes d'analyse numérique, l'analyse web, les systèmes CRM, la gestion du site Web et les technologies d'automatisation du marketing.

• Le succès démontré dans le développement des cadres d'ICK et l'utilisation des données pour stimuler la prise de décision et l'optimisation.

• Forte réflexion analytique avec des compétences exceptionnelles en littératie des données.

• Concentré commercialement avec une compréhension claire des facteurs de croissance et des résultats commerciaux.

Ce rôle est basé à Zurich mais passera à Baar en 2030, assurant un alignement étroit avec les principaux acteurs de l'entreprise.

Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?

Hai acquisito un'esperienza iniziale a supporto dei clienti istituzionali nella gestione degli asset e vuoi costruire una carriera nelle vendite istituzionali? Se siete appassionati di investimenti, gestione delle relazioni e sviluppo aziendale, questo ruolo offre un forte ingresso in uno dei principali asset manager della Svizzera.

All'interno del team dei Clienti Istituzionali Svizzeri, supporterete i fondi pensione, gli assicuratori e gli uffici familiari, contribuendo sia al nuovo sviluppo aziendale che al mantenimento delle relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine.

Questo ruolo si rivolge a candidati ambiziosi che mirano a trasferirsi in una posizione di gestione delle relazioni rispetto al cliente entro tre anni. Potrai inizialmente sostenere senior Relationship Manager, costruire una profonda comprensione di clienti, prodotti e processi di vendita, e gradualmente assumersi più responsabilità, tra cui l'interazione cliente diretta.

Forniamo la formazione, l'esposizione e la mentorship necessari per avere successo nelle vendite istituzionali. In cambio, cerchiamo individui motivati e curiosi desiderosi di sviluppare in sviluppatori di business di fiducia e alla fine gestire rapporti di cliente istituzionali indipendentemente.

La posizione si adatta ai candidati con la prima esperienza nel servizio clienti, nel supporto vendite o nella gestione delle relazioni in asset management che sono pronti a svolgere il prossimo passo in un ruolo di vendita front-office.

If you are passionate about investments, relationship management and business development, this role offers a strong entry into one of Switzerland’s leading asset managers.

Within the Swiss Institutional Clients team, you will support pension funds, insurers and family offices, contributing to both new business development and the maintenance of long-term client relationships.

This role targets ambitious candidates aiming to move into a client-facing relationship management position within three years. You will initially support senior Relationship Managers, build a deep understanding of clients, products and sales processes, and gradually take on more responsibility, including direct client interaction.

We provide the training, exposure and mentorship needed to succeed in institutional sales. In return, we seek motivated, curious individuals eager to develop into trusted business developers and eventually manage institutional client relationships independently.

The position suits candidates with first experience in client servicing, sales support or relationship management in asset management who are ready to take the next step into a front-office sales role.

What would your role be?

• You support Relationship Managers in managing and growing institutional client relationships.

• You maintain CRM data, sales pipelines and reporting as well as contribute to process improvements and digital initiatives.

• In a second step, you link the team members with one Vontobel investment boutique and become the team’s content expert for this asset class.

• In a final step, you join client events, meetings and pitches to learn the relationship management role.

What are we looking for?

• Initial experience within institutional client servicing, sales support, client relationship management or a similar role within asset management.

• A clear ambition to pursue a long-term career in institutional sales and client relationship management.

• Master’s degree with an excellent academic record, seeking an opportunity in an international work environment

• Strong interest in financial markets, investments and institutional asset management.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proactive, curious and commercially minded with a strong sense of ownership.

• Fluency in German and English.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint and Word), with ideally some experience of CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) and the effective use of data and AI tools for market intelligence, research and analytical purposes.

What do we offer?

• Opportunity to work for a leading active asset manager in an international environment and develop expertise in active asset management working with institutional clients

• Top Zurich location

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in over 25 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

Avez-vous acquis une expérience initiale de soutien aux clients institutionnels en gestion d'actifs et voulez-vous construire une carrière dans les ventes institutionnelles? Nous offrons la formation, l'exposition et le mentorat nécessaires pour réussir dans les ventes institutionnelles. En retour, nous recherchons des personnes motivées et curieuses désireuses de se développer en développeurs d'affaires fiables et éventuellement gérer les relations avec les clients institutionnels indépendamment.

Quel serait votre rôle ?

• Vous aidez les gestionnaires de relations à gérer et à développer les relations avec les clients institutionnels.

• Vous supportez les DP, les DDQ ainsi que les demandes d'information des clients.

• Vous maintenez des données CRM, des pipelines de vente et des rapports ainsi que contribuer aux améliorations des processus et aux initiatives numériques.

• Dans un deuxième temps, vous liez les membres de l'équipe à une boutique d'investissement Vontobel et devenez l'expert en contenu de l'équipe pour cette classe d'actifs.

• Dans une dernière étape, vous rejoignez des événements clients, des réunions et des emplacements pour apprendre le rôle de gestion de la relation.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?

• Expérience initiale dans le domaine du service à la clientèle institutionnelle, du soutien aux ventes, de la gestion des relations avec la clientèle ou d'un rôle semblable dans la gestion des biens.

• Une ambition claire de poursuivre une carrière à long terme dans les ventes institutionnelles et la gestion des relations client.

• Maîtrise avec un excellent dossier académique, à la recherche d'une opportunité dans un environnement de travail international

• Intérêt marqué pour les marchés financiers, les investissements et la gestion des actifs institutionnels.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des intervenants.

• Proactive, curieuse et commercialement soucieuse d'un fort sentiment de propriété.

• Connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais.

• Compétence en applications Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint et Word), avec idéalement une certaine expérience des systèmes CRM (par exemple Salesforce) et l'utilisation efficace des données et des outils d'intelligence artificielle à des fins d'intelligence commerciale, de recherche et d'analyse.

Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?

• Possibilité de travailler pour un gestionnaire actif de premier plan dans un environnement international et de développer une expertise en gestion active des actifs avec des clients institutionnels

• Haut lieu de Zurich

• Une équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un espace ouvert.

• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance l'un pour l'autre.

• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux.

Nous cherchons des gens talentueux, pas seulement un CV qui coche toutes les boîtes. Même si vous n'avez pas absolument tout ce que nous avons demandé, si ce rôle vous semble bon, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. Nous avons plus de 2300 professionnels engagés, basés dans plus de 25 endroits dans le monde et dont le siège est à Zurich.

Animé par un état d'esprit de propriété, vous pouvez débloquer votre potentiel et traduire des idées en opportunités. Nous embauchons des personnes talentueuses qui sont déterminées à agir dans un monde en évolution et qui viennent d'horizons très variés. Tu veux être Vontobel ?

At Vontobel, we actively shape the future. We believe in empowering our clients – and our people – to build on their strengths and unlock new potential. In this role, you will be responsible for critical Compliance and complex AML platforms, sanctions and adverse media screening as well as related investigation workflows. You will work closely with colleagues from Legal & Compliance, Operations and other IT colleagues to support, maintain and further develop reliable, scalable and compliant technology solutions.

• Implement and operate scalable software solutions using modern engineering best practices.

• Own the technical lifecycle of screening platforms including sanctions, PEP, adverse media and transaction screening solutions.

• Integrate external screening providers and internal banking applications through APIs and event-driven architectures.

• Partner with Compliance SMEs to translate regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions.

• Manage application upgrades, vendor releases and technical roadmaps.

• Identify and implement AI-driven solutions supporting business and engineering objectives.

• Drive automation and operational excellence across screening and investigation processes.

• Ensure auditability, traceability and regulatory compliance of implemented solutions.

• Enable end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives.

• Take ownership for project implementation including timelines, budgets, risks, and dependencies.

• Support stakeholders through actionable data analysis and intuitive data visualizations.

This role offers a high degree of ownership and autonomy. You will play a key role in operating the architecture, technology choices and strategic direction of Vontobel's Compliance and Screening platforms.

What are we looking for?

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, preferably within financial services or a regulated environment.

• Proven experience as a technical operations engineer/application specialist supporting Compliance, AML, KYC or screening solutions.

• A good understanding of sanctions screening, PEP screening, adverse media screening and AML processes.

• Hands-on experience with API development and system implementation.

• Solid knowledge of Python, GitHub, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Helm, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, SQL / PL-SQL. Knowledge of Java, Spring and Neo4j Graph Database is a plus.

• Experience in software implementation and technical project management.

• Experience with messaging and integration technologies.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluency in English and German.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di gestire soluzioni tecnologiche Compliance e AML che aiutano a salvaguardare la banca e i suoi clienti? Ti piace sostenere il funzionamento quotidiano, il monitoraggio, la manutenzione e il miglioramento continuo delle applicazioni correlate alla conformità, e lavorare con tecnologie innovative, tra cui analisi e AI? Si prospera in ambienti collaborativi e si diverte a lavorare con tecnologie all'avanguardia? Unisciti a noi e aiutaci a gestire la futura architettura Compliance a Vontobel.
A Vontobel, formiamo attivamente il futuro. Crediamo nel dare ai nostri clienti – e ai nostri popoli – di costruire sui loro punti di forza e sbloccare nuove potenzialità. All'interno del team Legal & Compliance Platforms, stiamo cercando un Compliance Operations Engineer / Application Specialist che è pronto a prendere la proprietà di soluzioni avanzate nel campo del supporto delle applicazioni, analisi dei dati e AI.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?
In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili per la Compliance critica e complesse piattaforme AML, sanzioni e screening dei media avversi e relativi flussi di lavoro di indagine. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con colleghi di Legal & Compliance, Operations e altri colleghi IT per supportare, mantenere e sviluppare soluzioni tecnologiche affidabili, scalabili e conformi.

• Implementare e gestire soluzioni software scalabili utilizzando le migliori pratiche ingegneristiche moderne.

• Proprio il ciclo di vita tecnico di piattaforme di screening tra cui sanzioni, PEP, mezzi di comunicazione avversi e soluzioni di screening delle transazioni.

• Integra fornitori di screening esterni e applicazioni bancarie interne attraverso API e architetture basate su eventi.

• Partner con le PMI Compliance per tradurre i requisiti normativi in soluzioni tecniche scalabili.

• Gestisci gli aggiornamenti delle applicazioni, le versioni dei fornitori e le roadmap tecniche.

• Identificare e implementare soluzioni AI-driven che supportano gli obiettivi aziendali e di ingegneria.

• Guidare l'automazione e l'eccellenza operativa nei processi di screening e indagine.

• Assicurare l'auditability, la tracciabilità e la conformità normativa delle soluzioni implementate.

• Abilitare la consegna end-to-end di complesse iniziative tecnologiche.

• Prendere la proprietà per l'attuazione del progetto, tra cui tempi, budget, rischi e dipendenze.

• Supporta gli stakeholder attraverso analisi dei dati attuabili e visualizzazioni intuitive dei dati.

Questo ruolo offre un alto grado di proprietà e autonomia. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel funzionamento dell'architettura, delle scelte tecnologiche e della direzione strategica delle piattaforme di Compliance e Screening di Vontobel.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Corso di laurea o Master in Informatica, Informatica o una disciplina relativa.

• 5+ anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria del software, preferibilmente all'interno di servizi finanziari o di un ambiente regolamentato.

• Esperienza comprovata come ingegnere o specialista di applicazioni tecniche che supportano soluzioni Compliance, AML, KYC o screening.

• Una buona comprensione di screening delle sanzioni, screening PEP, screening dei media avversi e processi AML.

• Esperienza pratica con sviluppo API e implementazione di sistema.

• Conoscenza solida di Python, GitHub, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Helm, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, SQL / PL-SQL. La conoscenza di Java, Spring e Neo4j Graph Database è un plus.

• Esperienza nell'implementazione del software e nella gestione dei progetti tecnici.

• Esperienza con le tecnologie di messaggistica e integrazione.

• Forte capacità di gestione analitica, problem solving e stakeholder.

• Fluency in inglese e tedesco.

• L'affinità per l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e la volontà di abbracciare strumenti e modi di lavoro abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale.

Cosa offriamo?

• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione e pranzo gratuito.

• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.

• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.

• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo.

Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare.

Richiesta posizione
Questo ruolo ha sede a Zurigo, ma si trasferirà a Baar nel 2030, garantendo un allineamento ravvicinato con i principali stakeholder del business.

Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Entro il 2030, vogliamo essere conosciuti come una delle principali e più affidabili aziende di investimento globali. Abbiamo 2.300 professionisti impegnati, con sede in 25+ sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo.
Siamo entrambi di proprietà della famiglia di maggioranza e pubblicamente elencati. La nostra capacità di attenzione a lungo termine, su temi come la sostenibilità, è sostenuta dalla sicurezza dell’impegno della famiglia di 100 anni. Guidato da una mentalità di proprietà, è possibile sbloccare il vostro potenziale e tradurre intuizioni in opportunità. Assumiamo individui di talento che sono determinati a fornire in un mondo mutevole e che provengono da una vasta gamma di sfondi.
Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

- Implementing automation in the build, test and deployment processes using CI/CD technologies to ensure a high level of software quality.
- Taking on 2nd/3rd-level support tasks for the systems you co-develop. In addition, the team provides on-call services, and a willingness to participate is required.
- Contributing new ideas to improve solutions and processes within the team and throughout the DigiHub.
- Taking ownership of topics and implementing them independently and in a structured manner in coordination with various stakeholders.
- Collaborating with a large number of internal and external stakeholders to achieve the best results.

What are we looking for?

- A degree in computer science or software development (ETH, university, FH, Swiss Federal Diploma).
- At least 6 years of experience in software development across the entire lifecycle (analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment), ideally in an agile or DevOps environment.
- Practical experience in building web applications with modern Single Page App Frameworks (Angular, SCSS) and microservice architectures based on Kotlin and Java.
- Experience in the banking sector and investment knowledge, preferably in an E-Banking environment including Avaloq.
- Bonus points for experience in iOS/Android development.
- Good German and English skills are required.
- An affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to work with AI Tools.

What do we offer?

- Start-up vibe and the opportunity to revolutionize the future of digital banking.
- Agile working environment with Big Room Plannings, cross-team guilds and communities, reviews and demos with clients and stakeholders.
- Well-equipped workplaces in a central location in Zurich, plenty of space for collaborative work, and a latest-generation MacBook Pro as a work device. A move to Baar, to one of Switzerland’s most modern business parks, is planned for 2030.
- Workmode with 1 regular home-office day per week (Wednesday or Friday).
- Free lunch in the high-quality employee restaurant, free coffee, fresh fruit every day, table football and celebratory drinks.

We are looking for talented people and not just a résumé that meets all the criteria. Even if you do not have everything we ask of you, you should apply.

Location

The position is currently based in Zurich. In 2030, the workplace will be relocated to Baar to further strengthen collaboration with the most important stakeholders in the business.

At Vontobel, you are shaping a better future—for our clients, society and yourself. As a family-run, publicly listed company with over 2,000 employees at 28 locations worldwide and headquarters in Zurich, we focus on long-term thinking and sustainability.

- Prise en charge de sujets et mise en œuvre autonome et structurée de ceux-ci en coordination avec différentes parties prenantes.

- Au moins 6 ans d’expérience dans le développement logiciel sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie (analyse, conception, implémentation, tests et déploiement), idéalement dans un environnement agile ou DevOps.
- Expérience pratique dans le développement d’applications web avec des frameworks modernes pour applications monopages (Angular, SCSS) et des architectures de microservices basées sur Kotlin et Java.

- Points supplémentaires pour une expérience en développement iOS/Android.
- De bonnes connaissances de l’allemand et de l’anglais sont requises.
- Affinité pour l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et volonté de travailler avec des outils d’IA.

Nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses, et pas uniquement des CV qui répondent à tous les critères. Même si vous ne réunissez pas tout ce que nous vous demandons, vous devriez quand même postuler.

Lieu de travail

Le poste est actuellement basé à Zurich. En 2030, le lieu de travail sera transféré à Baar afin de renforcer davantage la collaboration avec les principales parties prenantes de l’entreprise.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?

Chez Vontobel, vous contribuez à façonner un avenir meilleur – pour nos clients, la société et la vôtre. En tant qu’entreprise familiale cotée en bourse, comptant plus de 2.000 collaborateurs répartis sur 28 sites dans le monde et dont le siège est à Zurich, nous misons sur une vision à long terme et la durabilité.

Même si vous ne remplissez pas tous les critères, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature si le poste vous enthousiasme.

Souhaitez-vous devenir Vontobel ?

Nous vous remercions d’avoir postulé chez Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre candidature et vous répondrons dans les meilleurs délais.

jobs.title: Business & Risk Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur des affaires et des risques

jobs.description:
Are you an avid Business & Risk Manager who wants to make an impact? In our role you act as the operational and control backbone for the region. You bridge front-office teams with Zurich central functions (Finance, HR, Risk, Compliance, Legal) by translating regional strategy into budgets, staffing plans, and rigorous first-line controls.

The role splits roughly 40% business management, 40% first-line risk and control, and 20% regulatory readiness.

What would your role be?
1. Business Management & Planning (40%)

• Financial Oversight: Build and track regional budgets (revenue, cost, headcount) with monthly variance analysis.

• Resource Strategy: Develop forecasting models, resource plans, and headcount proposals with HR.

• Management Reporting: Produce regional KPI scorecards (revenue, net new money, cost/income ratio, pipeline capacity).

• Strategic Execution: Implement group-wide cost initiatives, process changes, and system rollouts locally.

2. First-Line Risk & Control (40%)

• Control Framework: Own, run, and document the regional first-line control framework.

• AML & KYC Oversight: Monitor onboarding files, KYC/EDD quality, and periodic reviews; escalate compliance gaps early.

• Incident Management: Track operational errors, incidents, and client complaints; lead root-cause analysis and remediation.

• Audit Coordination: Coordinate internal/external audits and drive audit findings through full closure.

• RCSA & KRIs: Maintain the regional Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and report Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to leadership.

3. Regulatory Readiness (20%)

• Regulatory Implementation: Support the rollout of regulatory strategies (e.g., CRD VI implementation).

• Compliance Standards: Oversee mandatory staff training and certifications.

• Inspections: Prepare and support the region for regulatory reviews and inspections.

What are we looking for?

• 8–12 years in Swiss private banking or wealth management (COO office, business management, or 1st-line risk/control).

• Deep understanding of FINMA circulars, AMLA/AMLO, and cross-border rules.

• Proven financial budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and advanced Excel/PowerPoint capabilities.

• Track record of managing strategic group-level projects or system rollouts.

• Highly credible with senior front-office bankers, with the ability to constructively challenge when necessary.

• Highly rigorous, structured, discreet, and capable of working independently across multiple sites.

• Fluent in French and English; working knowledge of German is strongly preferred for Zurich collaboration.

• Experience with GCC/Middle East clients or the External Asset Manager (EAM) segment is a plus.

What we offer

• Top Geneva location

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space with modern equipment.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.

• Campus feeling and collaborative spirit.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 29 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.

Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei un avido Business & Risk Manager che vuole fare un impatto? Nel nostro ruolo si agisce come la spina dorsale operativa e di controllo per la regione. Si affiancano le squadre di front-office con funzioni centrali di Zurigo (Finance, HR, Risk, Compliance, Legal) traducendo la strategia regionale in budget, piani di personale e rigorosi controlli di prima linea.

Il ruolo si divide circa il 40% di gestione aziendale, il 40% di rischio e controllo di prima linea, e il 20% di prontezza normativa.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?
1. Gestione aziendale e pianificazione (40%)

• Supervisione finanziaria: Costruire e monitorare i bilanci regionali (revenue, cost, headcount) con analisi mensile delle variazioni.

• Strategia delle risorse: Sviluppare modelli di previsione, piani di risorse e proposte del headcount con HR.

• Gestione Reporting: Produrre schede di punteggio KPI regionali (revenue, netto nuovo denaro, rapporto costo / reddito, capacità pipeline).

• Esecuzione strategica: implementare iniziative di costo a livello di gruppo, cambiamenti di processo e rollout di sistema a livello locale.

2. Rischio e controllo della prima linea (40%)

• Quadro di controllo: Possedere, eseguire e documentare il quadro di controllo regionale di prima linea.

• AML & KYC Supervisione: Monitorare i file di bordo, la qualità KYC/EDD e le recensioni periodiche; intensificare le lacune di conformità presto.

• Gestione degli incidenti: monitorare gli errori operativi, gli incidenti e i reclami dei clienti; condurre l'analisi e la bonifica delle cause root.

• Coordinamento Audit: Coordinate verifiche interne/esterne e i risultati dell'audit drive attraverso la completa chiusura.

• RCSA & KRIs: Mantenere l'autovalutazione regionale del rischio e del controllo (RCSA) e riportare gli indicatori chiave del rischio (KRI) alla leadership.

3. Prontezza regolamentare (20%)

• Attuazione normativa: Sostenere il rollout delle strategie di regolamentazione (ad esempio, implementazione CRD VI).

• Standard di conformità: supervisionare la formazione obbligatoria del personale e le certificazioni.

• Ispezioni: Preparare e sostenere la regione per le recensioni e le ispezioni regolamentari.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• 8-12 anni in private banking svizzero o gestione patrimoniale (ufficio COO, gestione aziendale, o rischio / controllo di 1a linea).

• Profonda comprensione delle circolari FINMA, AMLA/AMLO e delle regole transfrontaliere.

• Prova budgeting finanziario, previsione, analisi varianza e funzionalità avanzate Excel/PowerPoint.

• Tracciare il record di gestione di progetti strategici a livello di gruppo o rollout di sistema.

• Altamente credibile con banchieri di front-office senior, con la capacità di sfida costruttivamente quando necessario.

• Altamente rigoroso, strutturato, discreto, e capace di lavorare indipendentemente attraverso più siti.

• Fluente in francese e inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco è fortemente preferita per la collaborazione di Zurigo.

• L'esperienza con i clienti GCC/Middle East o il segmento EAM (Externative Asset Manager) è un vantaggio.

Cosa offriamo

• Top Ginevra posizione

• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio open-office con attrezzature moderne.

• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione su tutti i livelli.

• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo.

Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 29 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine.

Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo.

Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

Sind Sie ein begeisterter Business & Risk Manager, der etwas bewirken möchte? In unserer Rolle fungieren Sie als operatives und kontrollierendes Rückgrat für die Region. Sie überbrücken Front-Office-Teams mit zentralen Funktionen (Finanzen, HR, Risiko, Compliance, Recht), indem Sie regionale Strategien in Budgets, Personalpläne und strenge First-Line-Kontrollen übersetzen.

Die Rolle teilt sich etwa 40% Business Management, 40% First-Line-Risiko und Kontrolle und 20% regulatorische Bereitschaft.

Was wäre Ihre Rolle?
1. Business Management & Planung (40%)

• Finanzielle Aufsicht: Bauen und verfolgen Sie regionale Budgets (Einnahmen, Kosten, Mitarbeiterzahl) mit monatlicher Varianzanalyse.

• Ressourcenstrategie: Entwicklung von Prognosemodellen, Ressourcenplänen und Vorschlägen für Mitarbeiter mit HR.

• Management Reporting: Produzieren Sie regionale KPI-Scorecards (Umsatz, Netto-Neugeld, Kosten-Einkommens-Verhältnis, Pipeline-Kapazität).

• Strategische Ausführung: Implementieren Sie gruppenweite Kosteninitiativen, Prozessänderungen und System-Rollouts lokal.

2. First-Line Risiko & Kontrolle (40%)

• Kontrollrahmen: Besitzen, führen und dokumentieren Sie den regionalen First-Line-Kontrollrahmen.

• AML & KYC Oversight: Überwachen Sie Onboarding-Dateien, KYC / EDD-Qualität und regelmäßige Überprüfungen; Eskalieren Sie Compliance-Lücken frühzeitig.

• Incident Management: Verfolgen Sie operative Fehler, Vorfälle und Kundenbeschwerden; Lead Root-Causal-Analyse und Behebung.

• Auditkoordinierung: Koordinieren Sie interne / externe Audits und fördern Sie die Auditergebnisse durch den vollständigen Abschluss.

• RCSA & KRIs: Behalten Sie die regionale Risiko- und Kontrollselbsteinschätzung (RCSA) bei und melden Sie Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) an die Führung.

3. Regulatorische Bereitschaft (20%)

• Regulatorische Umsetzung: Unterstützung der Einführung von Regulierungsstrategien (z. B. CRD VI-Implementierung).

• Compliance-Standards: Beaufsichtigen Sie die obligatorischen Schulungen und Zertifizierungen des Personals.

• Inspektionen: Bereiten und unterstützen Sie die Region für regulatorische Überprüfungen und Inspektionen.

Worauf warten wir?

• 8-12 Jahre im Schweizer Private Banking oder Wealth Management (COO Office, Business Management oder 1st-line Risk/Control).

• Tiefes Verständnis für FINMA-Rundschreiben, AMLA/AMLO und grenzüberschreitende Regeln.

• Bewährte Finanzbudgetierung, Prognose, Varianzanalyse und erweiterte Excel / PowerPoint-Funktionen.

• Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung von strategischen Projekten auf Gruppenebene oder System-Rollouts.

• Sehr glaubwürdig bei leitenden Front-Office-Bankern, mit der Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf konstruktiv herauszufordern.

• Sehr streng, strukturiert, diskret und in der Lage, unabhängig über mehrere Standorte hinweg zu arbeiten.

• Fließend Französisch und Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse werden für die Zürcher Zusammenarbeit stark bevorzugt.

• Erfahrungen mit GCC / Middle East-Kunden oder dem Segment External Asset Manager (EAM) sind ein Plus.

Was wir anbieten

• Top Genfer Standort

• Freundliches, vielfältiges Team in einem Open-Office-Bereich mit moderner Ausstattung.

• Die neueste Technologie, die Ihnen hilft, sich zu profilieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

• Agile Umgebung, wie wir denken, wie wir arbeiten und unser Vertrauen füreinander.

• Flache Hierarchie mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen.

Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel bauen Sie eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft sowie für sich selbst. Als familiengeführtes und börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Fachleuten an 29 Standorten weltweit mit Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit.

Êtes-vous un gestionnaire d'affaires et de risques avide qui veut faire un impact? Dans notre rôle, vous agissez comme l'épine dorsale opérationnelle et de contrôle pour la région. Vous établissez un lien entre les équipes de première direction et les fonctions centrales de Zurich (Finances, RH, Risque, Conformité, Légal) en traduisant la stratégie régionale en budgets, plans de dotation et contrôles rigoureux de première ligne.

Le rôle consiste à répartir environ 40 % de la gestion des entreprises, 40 % des risques et du contrôle de première ligne et 20 % de l'état de préparation réglementaire.

Quel serait votre rôle ?
1. Gestion et planification des activités (40 %)

• Surveillance financière : Établissement et suivi des budgets régionaux (recettes, coûts, effectifs) avec analyse des écarts mensuels.

• Stratégie en matière de ressources : Élaborer des modèles de prévision, des plans de ressources et des propositions de dénombrement avec RH.

• Rapports de gestion : produire des cartes de pointage régionales de l'ICP (revenus, nouveaux fonds nets, rapport coûts-revenus, capacité des pipelines).

• Exécution stratégique : Mettre en oeuvre des initiatives de coûts à l'échelle du groupe, des changements de processus et des déploiements de systèmes au niveau local.

2. Risque et contrôle de première ligne (40 %)

• Cadre de contrôle : possède, exécute et documente le cadre de contrôle régional de première ligne.

• Surveillance AML & KYC: Surveiller les fichiers embarqués, la qualité KYC/EDD et les examens périodiques; aggraver les lacunes de conformité tôt.

• Gestion des incidents : suivre les erreurs opérationnelles, les incidents et les plaintes des clients; diriger l'analyse des causes profondes et l'assainissement.

• Coordination de la vérification : Coordonner les vérifications internes et externes et mener les constatations de la vérification jusqu'à la clôture complète.

• RCSA & KRI: Maintenir l'auto-évaluation des risques et des contrôles au niveau régional et faire rapport aux dirigeants des indicateurs de risque clés.

3. État de préparation à la réglementation (20 %)

• Mise en oeuvre de la réglementation : Appuyer la mise en oeuvre de stratégies réglementaires (p. ex. mise en oeuvre de la DRC VI).

• Normes de conformité : Superviser la formation et les certifications obligatoires du personnel.

• Inspections : Préparer et appuyer la région pour les examens et les inspections réglementaires.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?

• 8-12 ans en banque privée ou gestion de patrimoine suisse (bureau de COO, gestion d'entreprise, ou 1ère ligne risque/contrôle).

• Connaissance approfondie des circulaires FINMA, AMLA/AMLO et des règles transfrontalières.

• Budget financier éprouvé, prévisions, analyse de la variance et capacités avancées Excel/PowerPoint.

• Suivre l'état de la gestion des projets stratégiques au niveau des groupes ou des déploiements de systèmes.

• Très crédible avec des banquiers de premier plan, avec la capacité de défier de façon constructive au besoin.

• Très rigoureux, structuré, discret et capable de travailler indépendamment sur plusieurs sites.

• Fluent en français et en anglais; la connaissance de l'allemand est fortement préférée pour la collaboration de Zurich.

• L'expérience avec les clients du GCC/Middle East ou avec le segment External Asset Manager (EAM) est un plus.

Ce que nous offrons

• Haut lieu de Genève

• Équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un espace de bureau ouvert avec des équipements modernes.

• Toutes les dernières technologies pour vous aider à exceller et à progresser.

• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance l'un pour l'autre.

• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux.

• Sensation de campus et esprit de collaboration.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?
Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés dans 29 sites à l'échelle mondiale et ayant son siège à Zurich, nous sommes engagés dans la pensée et la durabilité à long terme.

Tu veux être Vontobel ?

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Fixed Income investing, particularly in Emerging Markets? Do you thrive in client-facing roles where you can act as a trusted advisor, not just a product pusher? Are you ready to leverage your expertise to drive global engagement and build substantial books of business? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!

At Vontobel, a leading investment firm managing over CHF 114bn in client assets, we are on an exceptional growth journey. With investment boutiques in New York (Quality Growth), London (TwentyFour Asset Management), and Zurich (Fixed Income, Multi Asset, Conviction Equities), we are seeking a Client Portfolio Manager (CPM) to champion our Emerging Markets Fixed Income (EM FI) flagship products.

As a CPM, you will play a pivotal role in representing our boutique investment team in the client experience, including prospect and consultant engagements. You will bring your client servicing and investment expertise and commercial acumen to advanced prospect situations, deliver exceptional client service, and act as a trusted advisor with a consultative, solution-oriented mindset. Reporting to the head of Fixed Income CPM, this entrepreneurial role offers the opportunity to be at the forefront of our global growth strategy while working closely with our Portfolio Managers, country client teams, RFP team and senior management.

What would your role be?

Role Details

• Originate and validate investment messaging, marketing materials, and written content, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance

• Ensure excellence in RFP responses, reporting, client engagement preparation, follow-up, and communication, setting industry-leading standards

• Represent the Emerging Markets Fixed Income Investment team in client, prospect, and consultant meetings, articulating our investment philosophy, strategy, and portfolio positioning with authority and clarity

• Collaborate with regional client teams to execute the EM FI engagement plan, including finals presentations, roadshows, event presentations, and performance review meetings

• Take a proactive, commercial perspective in advanced sales processes and client retention, co-leading business development initiatives to achieve sustainable growth

• Maintain in-depth knowledge of investment strategies by attending meetings, reviewing research, and leveraging information services to credibly represent the Investment Team

Key Deliverables

• Ensure excellence is desk based activities such as client servicing, RFP responses and content creation

• Drive impactful prospect and client meeting activity

• Support the growth of regionally prioritized EM FI products in alignment with the integrated sales plan, including training

• Build a strong reputation for Emerging Markets Fixed Income within all client region

• Be recognized internally and externally as their trusted EM FI expert and advisor, fostering long-term partnerships

• Ensure the accuracy and compliance of all external communications and materials

What are we looking for?

• A deep interest in Emerging Markets Fixed Income and the ability to communicate this enthusiasm to clients and stakeholders.

• A track record of building books of business and excelling in client-facing roles, including winning finals presentations and handling performance review meetings.

• The ability to tailor communication to diverse audiences across regions and formats, from one-on-one meetings to keynote speeches.

• Proficient in technology and automation including AI, MS Office, with strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint; Bloomberg and programming/scripting languages (VBA or Matlab) are a plus

• At least 2+ years of Fixed Income sell-side experience and institutional investment firm expertise.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or related field, Master Degree a plus

• CFA and/or other investment designations a plus

• A proactive, self-driven approach to working in a dynamic, investment-led team and international environment

• Willingness to travel extensively, both domestically and internationally, to meet the demands of a dynamic client engagement schedule.

• Native in German and fluency in English is required; additional languages like French and Italian are a plus.

What do we offer?

• Experienced, diverse team in an international environment

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.
