descriptionByLocale.fr:
Prêt à faire l'étape suivante de votre carrière et à faire votre marque dans le monde financier?
Chez Vontobel, nous croyons que diverses perspectives stimulent l'innovation et le succès. C'est pourquoi nous sommes heureux d'accueillir des étudiants passionnés, ambitieux et curieux dans notre programme de stages en début de carrière. Si vous êtes fasciné par la finance, la performance d'entreprise et la façon dont les décisions stratégiques se traduisent en résultats financiers, ce programme vous offre la possibilité de collaborer avec des équipes dynamiques de contrôle de groupe et d'entreprise, de recevoir un soutien personnalisé et de contribuer au travail qui crée une valeur tangible pour l'entreprise et nos actionnaires.
Sur 6 mois, à partir du 1er mars 2027, vous acquerrez une expérience pratique et des perspectives dans le secteur financier tout en établissant des liens durables dans une entreprise d'investissement mondialement reconnue.

Quel serait votre rôle ?
Dans le cadre du stage, vous pourrez :

• Acquérir une expérience de première main dans le domaine des partenariats d'affaires et comprendre comment le ministère des Finances appuie la prise de décisions.

• Développer une compréhension des principales entreprises de la Banque, y compris les clients privés, les clients institutionnels et les investissements, et les solutions structurées.

• Contribuer à l'établissement de rapports de gestion et à l'analyse du rendement, en développant une compréhension des principaux facteurs commerciaux et financiers.

• Participer aux processus de prévision et de planification, des hypothèses opérationnelles aux résultats financiers.

• Acquérir une expérience pratique avec les systèmes financiers et les outils de rapport, y compris Power BI et SAP.

• Construisez vos connaissances bancaires et financières par l'expérience pratique, la collaboration et le réseautage.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?
Ce que vous apportez
Nous recherchons des étudiants très motivés qui partagent nos valeurs :

• Propriété : Vous êtes curieux et vous engagez. Vous demandez pourquoi un processus fonctionne comme il le fait, vous proposez d'aider votre équipe là où elle en a besoin, et de voir vos propres projets à travers du début à la fin.

• Ténacité : Vous êtes entraîné et autonome. Lorsque les données ne s'additionnent pas ou que la première approche échoue, vous cherchez un autre moyen et vous revenez avec une réponse.

• Prévoyance : Vous êtes un auto-démarrage proactif avec une mentalité de can-do. Vous repèrez ce qui vient et vous prenez l'initiative de le résoudre avant qu'il ne devienne un problème.

Ce qui vous sépare

• Alphabétisation de l'IA : Vous utilisez des outils d'IA pour rechercher, analyser et rédiger plus rapidement, et vous revérifiez leur sortie avant de compter sur elle.

• Collaboration: Vous travaillez bien avec les autres et construisez votre réseau. Vous vous adressez à des collègues au-delà de votre propre équipe, apprenez comment d'autres parties de la banque fonctionnent et partagez ce que vous trouvez.

Ce que vous devez demander

• Vous êtes inscrit à un programme de baccalauréat ou de maîtrise, ou diplômé au cours des deux dernières années, en finance, comptabilité, contrôle, administration des affaires, économie, ou un domaine connexe.

• Vous avez un véritable intérêt dans le secteur financier.

• Vous parlez couramment anglais, écrit et parlé. Allemand, français ou italien est un plus.

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un permis de travail valide pour l'emplacement auquel vous faites une demande.

Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?
Chez Vontobel, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement inspirant où vous pourrez prospérer. Voici ce que vous pouvez attendre:

• Emplacement de Zurich : Espaces de collaboration modernes, et cantine gratuite sur place offrant des déjeuners fraîchement préparés pour vous maintenir sous tension.

• Culture solidaire et inclusive : Faites partie d'une équipe amicale et diversifiée qui valorise l'individualité et la collaboration dans un cadre ouvert.

• Outils de réussite : Accédez aux dernières technologies et ressources pour exceller dans votre rôle. · Possibilités de réseautage : rejoignez notre communauté NextGen et rencontrez d'autres stagiaires pour le déjeuner.

• Hiérarchie plate et innovation: Collaborer à tous les niveaux et contribuer à des projets passionnants dans un environnement de travail agile et axé sur l'avenir.

• Stage rémunéré : nous offrons un salaire standardisé pour tous les stagiaires en début de carrière, y compris le déjeuner gratuit.

La période de demande pour le Programme de stages de début de carrière de 2027 s'étend du 5 au 15 novembre. Comme les demandes sont examinées sur une base continue et que les postes peuvent fermer tôt, nous vous encourageons à présenter votre demande tôt. Vous pouvez soumettre un maximum de deux candidatures pour tous les postes de stage.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?
Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés dans 29 sites à l'échelle mondiale et ayant son siège à Zurich, nous sommes engagés dans la pensée et la durabilité à long terme.
Notre équipe diversifiée valorise des perspectives uniques, et nous embauchons des personnes déterminées à livrer dans un monde dynamique et changeant. Même si vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères, nous vous encourageons à postuler si vous êtes enthousiaste au sujet du rôle.
Tu veux être Vontobel ?

Merci d'avoir postulé à Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre demande et vous répondrons en temps opportun.

À Vontobel, nous sommes un lieu de travail à égalité des chances. Nous sommes attachés à l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, indépendamment de la race, de la couleur, de l'ascendance, de la religion, du sexe, de l'origine nationale, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'âge, de la citoyenneté, de l'état matrimonial, du handicap ou de l'identité de genre.
Nous apprécions les nombreuses voix au sein de nos équipes et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où tous ceux qui veulent faire partie de notre culture de la performance peuvent être eux-mêmes. Elle repose sur le respect mutuel et la tolérance zéro pour toute forme de discrimination.

Si vous avez des questions, vous pouvez nous contacter via notre formulaire de contact.

titleByLocale.fr: AI-Security Ingénieur

jobs.description:
For our IT Security division in Zurich, we are seeking an experienced and versatile AI Security Engineer and Architect. If you enjoy working in an agile team, thrive on tackling the daily challenges of a dynamic operating environment, and are excited to contribute to the implementation of complex projects using innovative technologies, this could be your chance!

Are concepts like prompt injection, adversarial inputs, model poisoning, zero trust AI, red teaming, or guardrails part of your daily language? Do you bring a strong understanding of how secure, enterprise grade AI systems are built, tested, and operated at scale? If this sounds familiar, we’d love to hear more about your experience and what inspires you to join our team!

What Would your role be?

• Software Development of IT Security and AI Security solutions.

• AI Security Architecture design and development.

• Technical ownership of security software solutions delivery.

What are we looking for?

• In-depth technical expertise in AI security threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques.

• Deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model (LLM) Applications.

• Proven experience in designing and securing agent-based AI architectures, including tool invocation, memory management, agent communication, and workflow orchestration.

• Experience implementing AI security testing and assurance practices, including red teaming, threat modeling, threat hunting, and risk assessments.

• Strong scripting and automation skills, with experience developing security tooling, scripts, and automated pipelines.

• Solid understanding of cloud security principles and controls, particularly within Microsoft Azure and AI/ML environments.

• Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or similar managed LLM services is an advantage.

• Agile, adaptable, and passionate about working in a fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic environment.

• Highly motivated and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

• Nice to have: experience securing Generative AI (GenAI) pipelines, including data ingestion, model training, evaluation, and deployment, against adversarial attacks, prompt injection, model manipulation, and data poisoning.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an international environment.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.

• Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

• Forte capacità di scrittura e automazione, con esperienza nello sviluppo di strumenti di sicurezza, script e pipeline automatizzate.

• Solida comprensione dei principi e dei controlli di sicurezza cloud, in particolare negli ambienti Microsoft Azure e AI/ML.

• Esperienza pratica con piattaforme AI come Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, o simili servizi LLM gestiti è un vantaggio.

• Agile, adattabile e appassionato di lavorare in un ambiente veloce, collaborativo e dinamico.

• Altamente motivato e proattivo, con un forte senso di proprietà e un impegno per l'apprendimento continuo e lo sviluppo professionale.

• Ottimo da avere: esperienza di sicurezza delle condotte Generative AI (GenAI), tra cui ingestione dei dati, formazione dei modelli, valutazione e distribuzione, contro attacchi avversari, iniezione rapida, manipolazione dei modelli e avvelenamento dei dati.

Cosa offriamo?

• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione e pranzo gratuito.

• Un team amichevole e diversificato in un ambiente internazionale.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione su tutti i livelli.

• Spirito collaborativo con opportunità di imparare e prosperare.

Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare.

Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. In qualità di azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine.
Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo.
Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

Pour notre division IT Security à Zurich, nous recherchons un ingénieur et architecte de la sécurité AI expérimenté et polyvalent. Si vous aimez travailler dans une équipe agile, réussir à relever les défis quotidiens d'un environnement opérationnel dynamique, et sont heureux de contribuer à la mise en œuvre de projets complexes utilisant des technologies innovantes, cela pourrait être votre chance!

Est-ce que des concepts comme l'injection rapide, les entrées adverses, l'empoisonnement du modèle, l'IA zéro confiance, l'équipe rouge, ou les garde-corps font partie de votre langage quotidien? Avez-vous une bonne compréhension de la façon dont les systèmes d'IA de qualité d'entreprise sont construits, testés et exploités à l'échelle? Si cela semble familier, nous aimerions en savoir plus sur votre expérience et ce qui vous inspire de rejoindre notre équipe!

Quel serait votre rôle ?

• Développement de logiciels de sécurité informatique et de solutions de sécurité AI.

• Architecture de sécurité AI conception et développement.

• Propriété technique des solutions logicielles de sécurité.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?

• Expertise technique approfondie en matière de menaces, de vulnérabilités et de techniques d'attaque liées à l'IA.

• Compréhension approfondie du Top 10 de l'OWASP et du Top 10 de l'OWASP pour les applications de modèles linguistiques de grande envergure (LLM).

• Expérience éprouvée dans la conception et la sécurisation d'architectures d'IA basées sur des agents, y compris l'invocation d'outils, la gestion de la mémoire, la communication d'agents et l'orchestration de flux de travail.

• Expérience de la mise en oeuvre de pratiques d'essai et d'assurance de la sécurité de l'IA, y compris l'équipe rouge, la modélisation des menaces, la chasse aux menaces et l'évaluation des risques.

• De solides compétences en script et en automatisation, avec une expérience de développement d'outils de sécurité, de scripts et de pipelines automatisés.

• Compréhension solide des principes et des contrôles de sécurité cloud, en particulier dans les environnements Microsoft Azure et AI/ML.

• Expérience pratique avec des plateformes d'IA telles que Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, ou des services LLM gérés similaires est un avantage.

• Agile, adaptable et passionné de travailler dans un environnement rapide, collaboratif et dynamique.

• Très motivé et proactif, avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation et un engagement envers l'apprentissage continu et le perfectionnement professionnel.

• Bonne à avoir: expérience de sécurisation Generative AI (GenAI) pipelines, y compris l'ingestion de données, la formation du modèle, l'évaluation, et le déploiement, contre les attaques adversaires, injection rapide, manipulation du modèle, et empoisonnement des données.

Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?

• Haut de Zurich avec des espaces de collaboration et déjeuner gratuit.

• Équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un environnement international.

• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance l'un pour l'autre.

• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux.

• Esprit de collaboration avec des occasions d'apprendre et de prospérer.

Nous cherchons des gens talentueux, pas seulement un CV qui coche toutes les boîtes. Même si vous n'avez pas absolument tout ce que nous avons demandé, si ce rôle vous semble bon, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?
Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés dans 28 sites à l'échelle mondiale et ayant son siège à Zurich, nous sommes engagés dans la réflexion et la durabilité à long terme.
Notre équipe diversifiée valorise des perspectives uniques, et nous embauchons des personnes déterminées à livrer dans un monde dynamique et changeant. Même si vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères, nous vous encourageons à postuler si vous êtes enthousiaste au sujet du rôle.
Tu veux être Vontobel ?

Merci d'avoir postulé à Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre demande et vous répondrons en temps opportun.

Chez Vontobel, nous sommes un lieu de travail à égalité des chances. Nous sommes attachés à l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, indépendamment de la race, de la couleur, de l'ascendance, de la religion, du sexe, de l'origine nationale, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'âge, de la citoyenneté, de l'état matrimonial, du handicap ou de l'identité de genre.
Nous apprécions les nombreuses voix au sein de nos équipes et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où tous ceux qui veulent faire partie de notre culture de la performance peuvent être eux-mêmes. Elle repose sur le respect mutuel et la tolérance zéro pour toute forme de discrimination.

Si vous avez des questions, vous pouvez nous contacter via notre formulaire de contact.

jobs.description:
Begeisterst du dich für die Finanzwelt? Für unser Team mit Fokus auf Schweizer Privatkunden suchen wir für unseren Standort in Zürich eine/n engagierte/n Client Associate, die/der unser Team tatkräftig unterstützt.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du betreust und unterstützt eigenverantwortlich die Verwaltung eines Kundenportfolios und stellst dabei die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundinnen und Kunden stets in den Mittelpunkt.

• Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für administrative Anliegen rund um Kundenbeziehungen, wie Cash Management, Überweisungen, Börsenaufträge und deren Überwachung, Erneuerungen von Treuhandanlagen sowie weitere Kontoaktivitäten.

• Du erkennst potenzielle Risiken frühzeitig durch die sorgfältige Überwachung von Risiko- und Compliance-Indikatoren.

• Du unterstützt die Relationship Manager bei KYC-Themen, der Organisation von Kundenterminen sowie der Vorbereitung von Anlagevorschlägen.

• Du sorgst für ein reibungsloses Onboarding neuer Kundinnen und Kunden sowie für die zeitgerechte Schliessung von Kundenbeziehungen.

Dein Profil

• Du verfügst über Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion innerhalb der Bankenbranche.

• Du kommunizierst fliessend auf Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Du bist eine teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Serviceorientierung und Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt.

• Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse von Finanzprodukten und Finanzmärkten.

• Du bringst sehr gute IT-Anwenderkenntnisse mit, insbesondere in MS Office und weiteren digitalen Tools.

• Du hast eine Affinität zu Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) und bist bereit, KI-gestützte Tools und moderne Arbeitsmethoden aktiv zu nutzen.

Das bieten wir dir

• Einen attraktiven Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Zürich mit modernen Arbeits- und Begegnungsräumen und kostenlosem Mittagessen.

• Ein kollegiales und vielfältiges Team in einer offenen und dynamischen Arbeitsumgebung.

• Modernste Technologien, die dich in deiner täglichen Arbeit und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung unterstützen.

• Ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Kultur des Vertrauens, der Eigenverantwortung und der Zusammenarbeit.

• Flache Hierarchien und einen unkomplizierten Austausch auf allen Ebenen.

• Eine inspirierende Campus-Atmosphäre mit starkem Teamgeist und einer ausgeprägten Zusammenarbeit.

Wir suchen talentierte Menschen und nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Anforderungen erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht sämtliche Kriterien mitbringst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass diese Position gut zu dir passt.
Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel gestaltest du bessere Zukunftsperspektiven, für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, für die Gesellschaft und für dich selbst. Als familiengeführtes und börsenkotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2'000 Mitarbeitenden an 29 Standorten weltweit und Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und nachhaltiges Handeln.
Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt unterschiedliche Perspektiven. Wir suchen Menschen, die engagiert sind, Verantwortung übernehmen und in einem dynamischen, sich ständig wandelnden Umfeld erfolgreich arbeiten möchten. Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich, dich zu bewerben, wenn du dich für die Aufgabe begeistern kannst.
Möchtest du Teil von Vontobel werden?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei emozionato per il mondo finanziario? Per il nostro team con un focus sui clienti privati svizzeri, stiamo cercando un socio cliente dedicato per la nostra posizione a Zurigo che supporterà attivamente il nostro team.

I tuoi compiti

• Sei responsabile e supporti la gestione di un portafoglio clienti e ti concentri sempre sulle esigenze dei nostri clienti.

• Sei il primo punto di contatto per questioni amministrative relative alle relazioni con i clienti, come la gestione dei contanti, trasferimenti, ordini di scambio e il loro monitoraggio, rinnovi di trust e altre attività di account.

• È possibile identificare i potenziali rischi in anticipo monitorando attentamente i rischi e gli indicatori di conformità.

• Sostieni i responsabili delle relazioni sugli argomenti KYC, l'organizzazione degli appuntamenti dei clienti e la preparazione di proposte di investimento.

• Garantisci una facile imbarco di nuovi clienti e la tempestiva conclusione dei rapporti con i clienti.

Il tuo profilo

• Hai esperienza in una funzione paragonabile all'interno del settore bancario.

• Si comunica fluentemente in tedesco e hanno una buona conoscenza dell'inglese così come forti capacità di comunicazione.

• Sei una personalità orientata al team con un alto livello di orientamento del servizio e il godimento del contatto diretto del cliente.

• Hai una buona conoscenza dei prodotti finanziari e dei mercati finanziari.

• Porti una buona conoscenza degli utenti IT, soprattutto in MS Office e in altri strumenti digitali.

• Hai un'affinità per l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e sono pronti a utilizzare attivamente strumenti basati sull'IA e metodi di lavoro moderni.

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un posto di lavoro attraente nel cuore di Zurigo con il lavoro moderno e sale riunioni e il pranzo gratuito.

• Un team collaborativo e diversificato in un ambiente di lavoro aperto e dinamico.

• Tecnologie all'avanguardia che ti supportano nel tuo lavoro quotidiano e nello sviluppo professionale.

• Un ambiente di lavoro agile con una cultura di fiducia, di proprietà e di collaborazione.

• Gerarchie piatte e uno scambio semplice a tutti i livelli.

• Un'atmosfera stimolante del campus con un forte spirito di squadra e una forte cooperazione.

Stiamo cercando persone di talento e non solo un CV che soddisfa tutti i requisiti. Anche se non portate tutti i criteri, non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione se sentite che questa posizione si adatta bene.
Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, crei prospettive future migliori per i nostri clienti, per la società e per te. Come azienda a conduzione familiare e quotata con oltre 2.000 dipendenti in 29 sedi in tutto il mondo e sede a Zurigo, ci concentriamo sul pensiero a lungo termine e sull'azione sostenibile.
Il nostro team diversificato apprezza diverse prospettive. Siamo alla ricerca di persone che si impegnano, si assumono la responsabilità e vogliono lavorare con successo in un ambiente dinamico e in continua evoluzione. Anche se non soddisfa tutti i requisiti, vi incoraggiamo fortemente ad applicare se siete entusiasti del compito.
Vuoi fare parte di Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you excited about the financial world? For our team with a focus on Swiss private customers, we are looking for a dedicated client associate for our location in Zurich who will actively support our team.

Your tasks

• You are responsible for and support the management of a customer portfolio and always focus on the needs of our customers.

• You are the first point of contact for administrative issues relating to customer relationships, such as cash management, transfers, exchange orders and their monitoring, renewals of trusts and other account activities.

• You can identify potential risks early on by carefully monitoring risk and compliance indicators.

• You support the relationship managers on KYC topics, the organization of customer appointments and the preparation of investment proposals.

• You ensure a smooth onboarding of new customers and the timely conclusion of customer relationships.

Your profile

• You have experience in a comparable function within the banking industry.

• You communicate fluently in German and have good knowledge of English as well as strong communication skills.

• You are a team-oriented personality with a high level of service orientation and enjoyment of direct customer contact.

• You have good knowledge of financial products and financial markets.

• You bring very good IT user knowledge, especially in MS Office and other digital tools.

• You have an affinity for artificial intelligence (AI) and are ready to actively use AI-based tools and modern working methods.

This is what we offer you

• An attractive workplace in the heart of Zurich with modern work and meeting rooms and free lunch.

• A collaborative and diverse team in an open and dynamic working environment.

• State-of-the-art technologies that support you in your daily work and professional development.

• An agile working environment with a culture of trust, ownership and collaboration.

• Flat hierarchies and an uncomplicated exchange at all levels.

• An inspiring campus atmosphere with a strong team spirit and strong cooperation.

We are looking for talented people and not just a CV that meets all requirements. Even if you do not bring all the criteria, we look forward to your application if you feel that this position suits you well.
Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you create better future prospects for our customers, for society and for yourself. As a family-run and listed company with over 2,000 employees at 29 locations worldwide and headquarters in Zurich, we focus on long-term thinking and sustainable action.
Our diverse team appreciates different perspectives. We are looking for people who are committed, take responsibility and want to work successfully in a dynamic, constantly changing environment. Even if you do not meet all the requirements, we strongly encourage you to apply if you are enthusiastic about the task.
Would you like to be part of Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form.

jobs.title: Life Insurance & Fiduciaria Specialist

titleByLocale.fr: Life Insurance & Fiduciaria Spécialiste

jobs.description:
Do you know your way around Life Insurance solutions and Italian Fiduciarie, and do you like being the person people call when a case gets complex? As our Life Insurance & Fiduciaria Specialist, you’ll connect our Relationship Managers with external partners and help grow a key part of our wealth management offering.

What the role would be like

• Manage relationships with assigned life insurers, brokers and Italian Fiduciarie. You’re the main contact for business, operational and contractual matters, including negotiating agreements

• Lead partner onboarding, due diligence and periodic reviews in line with internal governance and regulatory requirements

• Advise Relationship Managers on structuring and executing Life Insurance and Fiduciaria cases

• Monitor investment compliance of insurance portfolios and resolve guideline breaches with RMs, clients and partners

• Track regulatory and market developments and drive the resulting changes internally

• Run trainings that build RMs’ knowledge and grow business in these solutions

• Contribute to strategic projects, business development and the continuous improvement of processes, controls and operating models

You bring

• 5-10 years strong experience in the private insurance market, ideally in life insurance or Fiduciaria solutions

• Strong negotiation skills that allows you to secure good terms with insurers, brokers and Fiduciarie

• Business development and sales skills where you spot opportunities and turn them into business

• A university degree or equivalent professional qualification; a legal background is a strong plus

• A confident, professional presence with clients, partners and senior stakeholders

• An entrepreneurial, self-driven mindset and strong organisational skills

• Fluent English and German; Italian and/or French is a plus

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

• A role with real influence over the team, platform and transformation roadmap.

• A collaborative environment with direct communication and short decision paths.

• Learning, development and mentoring opportunities.

• Modern technology and close collaboration across business and technology.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

For our Wealth Planning department, we are looking for an experienced Sales & Business Manager to join us from 1 January 2027 on a 9-month fixed-term contract.
In this role, you will drive strategic initiatives, business development, and sales effectiveness within an interdisciplinary team of financial and estate planners, pension solutions and life insurance specialists, and tax experts.
As the operational and strategic backbone of the team, you will translate Wealth Planning priorities into measurable outcomes, actionable management insights, and tangible business results.
Working closely with front-office teams and specialist advisors, you will increase performance transparency, strengthen Wealth Planning's market positioning, and ensure the successful delivery of key strategic projects.

What would your role be?

• Performance & KPI Management: Monitor business performance, analyse KPIs, and recommend actions to optimize sales effectiveness, client engagement, and business results.

• Management Reporting & Business Analytics: Deliver management reporting, presentations, and data-driven insights to support executive decision-making and business growth.

• Business Development & Market Expansion: Identify growth opportunities and support the expansion of Wealth Planning capabilities across markets.

• Strategic Execution: Drive and coordinate strategic initiatives, growth programs, process improvements, and cross-divisional projects.

• Business Infrastructure: Lead the assessment, implementation, and rollout of new tools and business solutions to enhance efficiency, transparency, and scalability.

• Project Management: Lead strategic projects end-to-end, ensuring effective stakeholder management, timely delivery, and sustainable implementation.

You bring

• Several years of experience in Sales Management, Business Management, or Business Development within Swiss Private Banking or Wealth Management.

• University degree or equivalent qualification in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and derive meaningful business conclusions.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

• Demonstrated experience managing strategic projects, transformation initiatives, and CRM or system implementations (e.g. Salesforce).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

You are

• A strategic and analytical thinker with strong execution capabilities and a results-oriented mindset.

• A highly motivated self-starter who takes ownership, demonstrates resilience, and proactively drives topics forward.

• A structured, rigorous, and highly reliable professional, with a strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

What do we offer?
Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.
Friendly, diverse team in an international environment.
Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.
Flat hierarchy with collaboration on all levels.
Collaborative spirit with opportunities to learn and thrive.
We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Geschäftswachstum, strategische Umsetzung und Geschäftstransformation in der Vermögensplanung voranzutreiben?
Für unsere Wealth Planning Abteilung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Sales & Business Manager, der ab dem 1. Januar 2027 mit einem 9-monatigen befristeten Vertrag zu uns kommt.
In dieser Rolle treiben Sie strategische Initiativen, Geschäftsentwicklung und Vertriebseffektivität in einem interdisziplinären Team von Finanz- und Nachlassplanern, Altersvorsorge- und Lebensversicherungsspezialisten sowie Steuerexperten voran.
Als operatives und strategisches Rückgrat des Teams übersetzen Sie die Prioritäten der Vermögensplanung in messbare Ergebnisse, umsetzbare Management-Insights und greifbare Geschäftsergebnisse.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Front-Office-Teams und Fachberatern erhöhen Sie die Leistungstransparenz, stärken die Marktpositionierung von Wealth Planning und gewährleisten die erfolgreiche Umsetzung wichtiger strategischer Projekte.

Was wäre Ihre Rolle?

• Performance & KPI Management: Überwachen Sie die Geschäftsleistung, analysieren Sie KPIs und empfehlen Sie Maßnahmen zur Optimierung der Vertriebseffektivität, der Kundenbindung und der Geschäftsergebnisse.

• Management Reporting & Business Analytics: Bereitstellung von Management-Reporting, Präsentationen und datengesteuerten Erkenntnissen zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung und des Geschäftswachstums von Führungskräften.

• Business Development & Market Expansion: Identifizieren Sie Wachstumschancen und unterstützen Sie den Ausbau der Vermögensplanungsfähigkeiten in allen Märkten.

• Strategische Umsetzung: Strategische Initiativen, Wachstumsprogramme, Prozessverbesserungen und bereichsübergreifende Projekte vorantreiben und koordinieren.

• Business Infrastructure: Führen Sie die Bewertung, Implementierung und Einführung neuer Tools und Geschäftslösungen, um Effizienz, Transparenz und Skalierbarkeit zu verbessern.

• Projektmanagement: Führen Sie strategische Projekte Ende-zu-Ende, um ein effektives Stakeholder-Management, zeitnahe Lieferung und nachhaltige Umsetzung zu gewährleisten.

Sie bringen

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Sales Management, Business Management oder Business Development im Swiss Private Banking oder Wealth Management.

• Universitätsabschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten zu interpretieren, Trends zu identifizieren und aussagekräftige Geschäftsschlussfolgerungen abzuleiten.

• Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint.

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung im Management von strategischen Projekten, Transformationsinitiativen und CRM- oder Systemimplementierungen (z. B. Salesforce).

• Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Affinität für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und die Bereitschaft, KI-fähige Werkzeuge und Arbeitsweisen zu nutzen.

Du bist

• Ein strategischer und analytischer Denker mit starken Ausführungsfähigkeiten und einer ergebnisorientierten Denkweise.

• Ein hochmotivierter Selbststarter, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Resilienz zeigt und Themen proaktiv vorantreibt.

• Ein strukturierter, rigoroser und äußerst zuverlässiger Fachmann mit einer starken Liebe zum Detail und der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten unabhängig voneinander zu verwalten.

Was bieten wir an?

• Top Zürich Lage mit Collaboration Spaces und kostenlosem Mittagessen.

• Freundliches, vielfältiges Team in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Agile Umgebung, wie wir denken, wie wir arbeiten und unser Vertrauen füreinander.

• Flache Hierarchie mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen.

• Kooperationsgeist mit Möglichkeiten zu lernen und zu gedeihen.

Wir suchen talentierte Leute, nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Boxen ankreuzt. Auch wenn Sie nicht absolut alles haben, wonach wir gefragt haben, wenn diese Rolle nach einer guten Passform für Sie klingt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben.

Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel bauen Sie eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft sowie für sich selbst. Als familiengeführtes und börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Fachleuten an 28 Standorten weltweit mit Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit.
Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt einzigartige Perspektiven und wir stellen Einzelpersonen ein, die entschlossen sind, in einer dynamischen und sich verändernden Welt zu liefern. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie von der Rolle begeistert sind.

Wollen Sie Vontobel sein?

Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich bei Vontobel bewerben. Wir werden Ihre Bewerbung sorgfältig prüfen und Ihnen rechtzeitig antworten.

Bei Vontobel sind wir ein Chancengleichheitsarbeitsplatz. Wir verpflichten uns zu gleichen Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Staatsangehörigkeit, Familienstand, Behinderung oder Geschlechtsidentität.
Wir schätzen die vielen Stimmen in unseren Teams und setzen uns dafür ein, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder, der Teil unserer Leistungskultur sein möchte, er selbst sein kann. Sie basiert auf gegenseitigem Respekt und Null-Toleranz für jede Form von Diskriminierung.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, können Sie uns über unser Kontaktformular kontaktieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous passionné par la croissance des entreprises, l'exécution stratégique et la transformation des affaires dans la planification de patrimoine?
Pour notre service de planification de patrimoine, nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur commercial expérimenté pour nous rejoindre à partir du 1er janvier 2027 sur un contrat à durée déterminée de 9 mois.
Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des initiatives stratégiques, le développement des affaires et l'efficacité des ventes au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire de planificateurs financiers et immobiliers, de solutions de retraite et de spécialistes de l'assurance-vie, et d'experts fiscaux.
En tant qu'épine dorsale opérationnelle et stratégique de l'équipe, vous transformerez les priorités de la planification de patrimoine en résultats mesurables, en perspectives de gestion réalisables et en résultats opérationnels tangibles.
En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de front-office et les conseillers spécialisés, vous améliorerez la transparence des performances, renforcerez le positionnement du marché de Wealth Planning et assurerez la réussite des projets stratégiques clés.

Quel serait votre rôle ?

• Performance & KPI Management: Surveiller les performances d'entreprise, analyser les KPI et recommander des actions pour optimiser l'efficacité des ventes, l'engagement des clients et les résultats d'entreprise.

• Rapports de gestion et analyses d'affaires : Fournir des rapports de gestion, des présentations et des renseignements axés sur les données pour appuyer la prise de décisions et la croissance des entreprises.

• Développement des entreprises et expansion des marchés : Identifier les possibilités de croissance et appuyer l'expansion des capacités de planification de patrimoine dans tous les marchés.

• Exécution stratégique : Diriger et coordonner les initiatives stratégiques, les programmes de croissance, les améliorations des processus et les projets interdivisionnels.

• Infrastructure opérationnelle : Diriger l'évaluation, la mise en oeuvre et la mise en oeuvre de nouveaux outils et de nouvelles solutions pour améliorer l'efficacité, la transparence et l'évolutivité.

• Gestion de projet : Diriger les projets stratégiques de bout en bout, assurer une gestion efficace des intervenants, une mise en oeuvre en temps opportun et une mise en oeuvre durable.

Vous apportez

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en gestion des ventes, gestion d'entreprise ou développement d'entreprise au sein de Swiss Private Banking ou Wealth Management .

• Diplôme universitaire ou équivalent en finance, économie, administration des affaires, ou un domaine connexe.

• De solides compétences analytiques ayant une capacité éprouvée d'interpréter des données complexes, d'identifier les tendances et de tirer des conclusions commerciales significatives.

• Compétence avancée dans Microsoft 365 , en particulier Excel et PowerPoint .

• Expérience démontrée en gestion de projets stratégiques, d'initiatives de transformation et de mise en oeuvre de CRM ou de systèmes (p. ex. Salesforce).

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en allemand et en anglais.

• Affinité pour l'intelligence artificielle (IA) et volonté d'adopter des outils et des méthodes de travail compatibles avec l'IA.

Vous êtes

• Un penseur stratégique et analytique doté de solides capacités d'exécution et d'un état d'esprit axé sur les résultats.

• Un auto-démarrage très motivé qui s'approprie, fait preuve de résilience et fait avancer les sujets.

• Un professionnel structuré, rigoureux et hautement fiable, avec une grande attention aux détails et la capacité de gérer de multiples priorités indépendamment.

Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?

• Haut de Zurich avec des espaces de collaboration et déjeuner gratuit.

• Équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un environnement international.

• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance l'un pour l'autre.

• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux.

• Esprit de collaboration avec des occasions d'apprendre et de prospérer.

Nous cherchons des gens talentueux, pas seulement un CV qui coche toutes les boîtes. Même si vous n'avez pas absolument tout ce que nous avons demandé, si ce rôle semble être un bon ajustement pour vous, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?
Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés sur 28 sites à l'échelle mondiale et ayant son siège à Zurich, nous sommes engagés dans la pensée et la durabilité à long terme.
Notre équipe diversifiée valorise des perspectives uniques, et nous embauchons des personnes déterminées à livrer dans un monde dynamique et changeant. Même si vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères, nous vous encourageons à postuler si vous êtes enthousiaste au sujet du rôle.

Tu veux être Vontobel ?

Merci d'avoir postulé à Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre demande et vous répondrons en temps opportun.

À Vontobel, nous sommes un lieu de travail à égalité des chances. Nous sommes attachés à l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, indépendamment de la race, de la couleur, de l'ascendance, de la religion, du sexe, de l'origine nationale, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'âge, de la citoyenneté, de l'état matrimonial, du handicap ou de l'identité de genre.
Nous apprécions les nombreuses voix au sein de nos équipes et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où tous ceux qui veulent faire partie de notre culture de la performance peuvent être eux-mêmes. Elle repose sur le respect mutuel et la tolérance zéro pour toute forme de discrimination.

Si vous avez des questions, vous pouvez nous contacter via notre formulaire de contact.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato del mondo finanziario e ti piace costruire e mantenere relazioni durature con i clienti? La nostra scrivania EAM sta cercando un Relationship Manager per unirsi alla loro squadra.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?

• Assumere un portafoglio client esistente

• Sviluppare nuove connessioni client, portare relazioni client esistenti, e essere responsabile per l'acquisizione di nuovi business da clienti esistenti

• Agire come consulente affidabile per i clienti e le prospettive fornendo raccomandazioni che comprendono più prodotti e servizi

• Sviluppare una comprensione approfondita delle esigenze, delle preferenze e della ricchezza complessiva del cliente e rispondere ai cambiamenti nell’ambiente aziendale o alle esigenze dei clienti

• Efficacemente gestire il tuo libro dei clienti e agire come un rapporto responsabile per l'esperienza dei clienti

• Specialisti di levaggio, agenti di servizio e altre risorse di esperti per garantire la fornitura integrata di soluzioni fiduciarie, di credito e bancarie

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Una formazione nel campo della finanza o dell'economia

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza come Relationship Manager (l'esperienza che supporta gli asset manager esterni (EAM) è un bene)

• Una buona rete di potenziali clienti

• Un individuo orientato al cliente con eccezionali competenze interpersonali, elevata motivazione e spirito imprenditoriale

• Affidabilità finanziaria e commerciale orientata alla soluzione

• Proattivo, analitico e strutturato

• Un giocatore di squadra disposto ad andare il miglio supplementare e impegnato a fornire un livello di servizio costantemente alto

• Fluente in tedesco, inglese

Cosa offriamo

• Top Basel location con spazi di collaborazione (tra cui terrazze sul tetto) e pranzo gratuito.

• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio open-office con attrezzature moderne.

• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione su tutti i livelli.

• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo.

Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. In qualità di azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 29 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine.
Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo.
Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about financial crime prevention, risk analysis, and protecting the integrity of private banking? Join our Client Onboarding
& Reviews team in Zurich, where you’ll take on complex client assessments, investigate potential risks, and help safeguard sensitive client
relationships. From KYC and due diligence to PEP reviews and adverse media screening, you’ll combine your compliance expertise with the
power of AI to make smarter, risk-based decisions.
Bring your analytical mindset, curiosity, and collaborative spirit to a diverse, agile team where innovation meets impact—and where your
ideas can help shape the future of Compliance.

What would your role be?

• You will be part of the Onboarding and Review Team covering private clients with an increased risk as well Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs).

• You will be reporting to a Team Leader within the Client Onboarding and Reviews.

• Review client KYC information, account activities, negative news either as part of the on-boarding or review process and escalate issues to your management for decisioning.

• Good to strong knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, related tools and how to deploy it in day-to-day tasks assigned to you.

• Performing assessments, participating in projects and assist the Onboarding and Review team in all aspects of the day-to-day business.

In this role, your main duties and responsibilities include:

• Assisting the teams within Client Onboarding and Reviews in performing their day-to-day tasks as well as participate, where required, in compliance related projects.

• Ensuring Compliance with policies and procedures throughout your entire duties in client lifecycle, including onboarding, periodic reviews, event-driven reviews and ad-hoc client assessments.

• Conducting risk-based Compliance assessments for client onboardings, including KYC, due diligence, sanctions screening, adverse media reviews and reputational risk assessments.

• Performing Compliance assessments related to periodic and event-driven client reviews, with a particular focus on politically exposed persons (PEPs), high-risk clients, sanctions-related matters and other sensitive client relationships.

• Escalating AML concerns / issues to your management for assessment and decisioning.

• Assist in preparing Compliance assessments and case presentations for senior management and governance committees to facilitate decision-making on high-risk and complex client relationships.

• Assist in conducting internal controls, quality assurance reviews and monitoring activities to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.

What are we looking for?

• University degree and compliance related certifications.

• 2 years of Anti-Money related/Compliance experience in Switzerland Private Banking, preferably in the area of client due diligence, source of wealth and negative news screening

• Eloquent and capable of analyzing, summarizing and presenting in a succinct way in written form as well as verbally in English.

• Fluent in English and German, other languages such as French and Arabic a plus.

• Affinity for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a willingness to embrace AI-enabled tools and ways of working.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Location Requirement
This role is based in Zurich but will move to Baar in 2030, ensuring close alignment with key stakeholders in the business.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di prevenzione della criminalità finanziaria, analisi del rischio e protezione dell'integrità del private banking? Iscriviti al nostro cliente Onboarding
& Recensioni team di Zurigo, dove prenderete valutazioni complesse dei clienti, indagare sui potenziali rischi e aiutare a salvaguardare i clienti sensibili
relazioni. Da KYC e due diligence a recensioni PEP e screening dei media negativi, unirete la vostra competenza di conformità con la
potere di AI per prendere decisioni più intelligenti e basate sul rischio.
Porta la tua mentalità analitica, la curiosità e lo spirito collaborativo a un team diverso e agile in cui l'innovazione incontra l'impatto e dove il tuo
Le idee possono contribuire a plasmare il futuro della conformità.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?

• Sarete parte del team di bordo e revisione che copre clienti privati con un maggiore rischio e anche Politicamente Esposta Persone (PEP).

• Ti riferirai a un Team Leader all'interno del Client Onboarding e Recensioni.

• Rivedere le informazioni del cliente KYC, le attività del conto, notizie negative sia come parte del processo di on-boarding o revisione e problemi di escalate alla vostra gestione per la decisione.

• Buona a forte conoscenza dell'Intelligenza Artificiale, strumenti correlati e come distribuirlo nei compiti quotidiani assegnati a voi.

• Effettuare valutazioni, partecipare a progetti e assistere il team Onboarding and Review in tutti gli aspetti del business quotidiano.

In questo ruolo, i vostri doveri e responsabilità principali includono:

• Assistere i team all'interno di Customer Onboarding e Recensioni nell'esecuzione delle loro attività quotidiane, nonché partecipare, ove richiesto, ai progetti relativi alla conformità.

• Garantire la conformità con le politiche e le procedure durante tutta la vostra attività nel ciclo di vita del cliente, tra cui onboarding, revisioni periodiche, recensioni organizzate per eventi e valutazioni dei clienti ad-hoc.

• Condurre valutazioni di conformità basate sui rischi per le onboarding dei clienti, tra cui KYC, due diligence, screening delle sanzioni, recensioni negative dei media e valutazioni di rischio reputazionali.

• Esecuzione delle valutazioni di conformità relative alle revisioni periodiche e degli eventi, con una particolare attenzione alle persone esposte politicamente (PEP), ai clienti ad alto rischio, alle questioni relative alle sanzioni e ad altre relazioni con i clienti sensibili.

• Escalation AML preoccupazioni / problemi alla vostra gestione per la valutazione e la decisione.

• Assistere nella preparazione delle valutazioni di conformità e delle presentazioni di casi per i comitati di gestione e governance senior per facilitare il processo decisionale sulle relazioni client ad alto rischio e complesse.

• Assistere nella conduzione di controlli interni, recensioni di garanzia della qualità e attività di monitoraggio per garantire l'adesione a requisiti normativi e politiche interne.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Laurea universitaria e certificazione di conformità.

• 2 anni di esperienza di Anti-Money/Compliance in Svizzera Private Banking, preferibilmente nell'area di due diligence cliente, fonte di ricchezza e proiezione di notizie negative

• Eloquente e capace di analizzare, riassumere e presentare in modo succinta in forma scritta così come verbalmente in inglese.

• Fluente in inglese e tedesco, altre lingue come francese e arabo un plus.

• L'affinità per l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e la volontà di abbracciare strumenti e modi di lavoro abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale.

Cosa offriamo?

• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione e pranzo gratuito.

• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.

• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.

• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo.

Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare.

Richiesta posizione
Questo ruolo ha sede a Zurigo, ma si trasferirà a Baar nel 2030, garantendo un allineamento ravvicinato con i principali stakeholder del business.

Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine.
Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo.
Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .

relations. Depuis KYC et la diligence raisonnable jusqu'aux examens PEP et le dépistage des médias indésirables, vous combinerez votre expertise en matière de conformité avec les
pouvoir de l'IA de prendre des décisions plus intelligentes et fondées sur le risque.

les idées peuvent aider à façonner l'avenir de la conformité.

• Passez en revue l'information du client KYC, les activités de compte, les nouvelles négatives dans le cadre du processus d'embarquement ou d'examen et augmentez les problèmes à votre direction pour décision.

• Assurer la conformité aux politiques et aux procédures tout au long de vos tâches dans le cycle de vie des clients, y compris l'embarquement, les examens périodiques, les examens axés sur les événements et les évaluations ad hoc des clients.

Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?

• Haut de Zurich avec des espaces de collaboration et déjeuner gratuit.

Emplacement requis
Ce rôle est basé à Zurich, mais sera transféré à Baar en 2030, assurant un alignement étroit avec les principaux acteurs de l'entreprise.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?
Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés sur 28 sites à l'échelle mondiale et ayant son siège à Zurich, nous sommes engagés dans la réflexion et la durabilité à long terme.

jobs.title: Investment Advisor

titleByLocale.fr: Investment Conseiller

jobs.description:
We are looking for an initiative, independent and persuasive personality who is willing to take on great responsibility & challenging tasks as an Investment Advisor with a focus on asset allocation and theme investing.

What would your role be?

• Developing investment themes and topics for strategic implementation as well as tactical investment calls

• Further develop the business reach of Vontobel’s Module-based, holistic investment solution “Select”

• Developing personalized investment strategies and tactical positionings based on clients needs and views for implementation in “Select”

• Providing the investment advisory team with investment ideas and topics on a short-term (opportunistic) basis

• Identifying client needs and selecting investment instruments to implement strategic views as well as tactical calls in “Select” modules

• Monitoring “Select” implementation, including performance analyses and reporting

• Support client relationship managers with respect to the “Select” offering

What are we looking for?

• University degree in finance, further degrees like CFA (or similar) preferred

• Experience in the financial industry, with focus on top down investment processes covering mixed asset class allocations (e.g. CIO Office)

• Strong financial research background with ability to develop investment ideas and themes in a wealth management setting

• Strong client communication skills to position investment convictions and positions Vontobel’s expertise

• Investment product knowhow covering collective instruments (active, passive) as well as structured products and similar

• Strong technical skills as an advantage

• Ability to adjust according to audience as we communicate to clients across different regions and channels

• Conviction to achieve our goals with our business partners

• Highly motivated team player

• Flexible, proactive, open-minded attitude, with a strong desire to drive innovation and improve things

• Excellent knowledge and experience in financial markets and instruments, portfolio management and investments

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German, English and strong client presentation and communication skills. French would be a strong asset.

What do we offer?

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.
Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 29 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. jobs.title: Early Careers Internship Program Risk

titleByLocale.it: Early Careers Programma di stage Risk
titleByLocale.fr: Early Careers Programme de stage Risk

jobs.description:
Ready to take the next step in your career and make your mark in the financial world?
At Vontobel, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. That’s why we’re excited to welcome passionate, ambitious, and curious students into our Early Careers Internship Program. Whether you’re fascinated by finance, risk management, regulatory aspects and governance this program offers you the chance to collaborate with a dynamic team, receive personalized support, and contribute to projects that truly matter.
Over 6 months, starting on 1 March 2027, you’ll gain hands-on experience and insights into the financial industry while building lasting connections in a globally recognized investment firm.

What would your role be?
As part of the internship, you will:

• Connect the events, themes and risk across the bank by supporting the further enhancement and alignment of enterprise, operational and resilience risk frameworks, including risk appetite, risk taxonomy, risk governance and the interaction between different risk types.

• Work across the bank’s Three Lines of Defense, engaging with business units and colleagues across Risk, Compliance, Technology, Finance and other control functions to understand how business activities, risks, processes and controls interact.

• Contribute to risk analysis and oversight across operational incidents, emerging risks, regulatory developments, risk culture and resilience scenarios, helping identify risk concentrations, control weaknesses and common risk drivers.

• Turn risk information into management insight by supporting risk reporting, dashboards, committee materials and presentations preparations that enable senior management and governance bodies to understand the bank’s risk profile and make informed decisions.

• Help strengthen and simplify risk management processes by improving the connection between risk appetite, incidents, issues, controls, risk assessments and resilience, while identifying opportunities for better data, automation and more efficient workflows.

• Explore how AI can enhance risk management, including the responsible use of AI to support risk identification, analysis, control assessment and management reporting, while considering appropriate governance and human oversight.

• Gain insights into the bank’s corporate governance and understand how risk information is escalated, challenged and translated into decisions by management, risk committees and the Board.

• Bring a fresh perspective to Enterprise Risk Control, applying curiosity, analytical thinking and constructive challenge to help the bank continuously strengthen how it identifies, assesses, manages and monitors risk.

What are we looking for?
What you bring
We are seeking highly motivated students that share our values :

• Ownership : You are curious and get involved. You ask why a process works the way it does, offer to help where your team needs it, and see your own projects through from start to finish.

• Tenacity : You are driven and self-dependent. When the data doesn’t add up or the first approach fails, you look for another way and you come back with an answer.

• Foresight : You are a pro-active self-starter with a can-do mentality. You spot what’s coming and you take the initiative to solve it before it becomes a problem.

What sets you apart

• AI literacy : You use AI tools to research, analyze and draft faster, and you double-check their output before you rely on it.

• Collaboration: You work well with others and build your network. You reach out to colleagues beyond your own team, learn how other parts of the bank work, and share what you find.

What you need to apply

• You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program, or graduated within the last two years, in finance, technology or a related field.You have a genuine interest in the financial sector.You are fluent in English, written and spoken. German, French or Italian is a plus.You hold a valid work permit for the location you are applying to.

What do we offer?

Ecco perché siamo entusiasti di dare il benvenuto a studenti appassionati, ambiziosi e curiosi nel nostro programma di tirocinio Early Careers. Che tu sia affascinato dalla finanza, dalla gestione dei rischi, dagli aspetti normativi e dalla governance, questo programma ti offre la possibilità di collaborare con un team dinamico, di ricevere un supporto personalizzato e di contribuire a progetti davvero importanti.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?
Come parte dello stage, si:

• Collegare gli eventi, i temi e il rischio attraverso la banca supportando l'ulteriore miglioramento e allineamento delle strutture di rischio enterprise, operative e resilience, tra cui l'appetito del rischio, la tassonomia del rischio, la governance del rischio e l'interazione tra diversi tipi di rischio.

• Aiuta a rafforzare e semplificare i processi di gestione dei rischi migliorando la connessione tra appetito di rischio, incidenti, problemi, controlli, valutazioni dei rischi e resilienza, individuando al contempo opportunità di dati, automazione e flussi di lavoro più efficienti.

• Scopri come l'IA può migliorare la gestione dei rischi, tra cui l'uso responsabile dell'IA per supportare l'identificazione del rischio, l'analisi, la valutazione del controllo e il reporting di gestione, considerando l'appropriata governance e la supervisione umana.

• Acquisire informazioni sulla governance aziendale della banca e capire come le informazioni sul rischio sono escalate, sfidate e tradotte in decisioni da parte di comitati di gestione, di rischio e del Consiglio.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

Stiamo cercando studenti altamente motivati che condividono i nostri valori:

• Proprietario: Siete curiosi e coinvolti. Chiedete perché un processo funziona come fa, offrire di aiutare dove il vostro team ha bisogno di esso, e vedere i vostri progetti attraverso dall'inizio alla fine.

• Tenacità: Lei è guidato e indipendente. Quando i dati non si sommano o il primo approccio fallisce, si cerca un altro modo e si torna con una risposta.

• Foresight: Lei è un auto-starter pro-attivo con una mentalità can-do. Si individua quello che sta arrivando e si prende l'iniziativa di risolverlo prima che diventi un problema.

Cosa ti fa a pezzi

• AI literacy: Si utilizza strumenti AI per la ricerca, l'analisi e la bozza più veloce, e si controlla il doppio della loro produzione prima di fare affidamento su di esso.

• Collaborazione: Lavori bene con gli altri e costruisci la tua rete. Si arriva a colleghi al di là del proprio team, imparare come altre parti del lavoro in banca, e condividere ciò che si trova.

Cosa offriamo?

• Cultura solidale e inclusiva: Partecipa a un team amichevole e diversificato che valorizza l'individualità e la collaborazione in un ambiente aperto.

• Strumenti per il successo: Accedi alle ultime tecnologie e risorse per eccellere nel tuo ruolo.

• Opportunità di rete: unisciti alla nostra comunità di NextGen e incontrare altri tirocinanti per il pranzo.

• Gerarchia piatta e innovazione: collaborare a tutti i livelli e contribuire a progetti entusiasmanti in un ambiente di lavoro agile e orientato al futuro.

• Stage a pagamento: offriamo lo stipendio standardizzato per tutti i primi tirocinanti, incluso il pranzo gratuito.

Poiché le applicazioni sono esaminate su una base di rotolamento e le posizioni possono chiudere presto, vi incoraggiamo a applicare presto. È possibile inviare un massimo di due applicazioni in tutte le posizioni di stage.

Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. In qualità di azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 29 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine.
Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo. Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro di pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Apprezziamo le molte voci all'interno dei nostri team e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui chiunque voglia far parte della nostra cultura delle prestazioni può essere se stesso. Essa si basa sul rispetto reciproco e sulla tolleranza zero per qualsiasi forma di discriminazione.

Se avete domande potete contattarci tramite il nostro modulo di contatto .
